blocks.text: Many people may experience tooth loss for various reasons. Although many people who experience tooth loss think that this problem is permanent and unsolvable, this is not actually the case, and it is not necessary to resort to methods such as the use of removable dentures to compensate for tooth loss. Implant treatment, in particular, offers individuals a highly ergonomic, advantageous, and safe solution for tooth loss. An implant is an artificial tooth root. Therefore, implant treatment makes it possible to have teeth that are so functional and aesthetic that they are almost indistinguishable from real teeth.

Although implant treatments are highly effective, if the dentist for implant treatment is not chosen correctly, you may experience more harm than benefit from these methods. If you choose a healthcare institution such as Dentaliva, which many individuals are satisfied with and recommend, within the scope of implant treatment recommendations, you can enjoy the advantages of reliable and professional healthcare services. If performed by specialist implant dentists, especially those with extensive experience in oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery, your expertly placed implants may even last a lifetime. In addition to all this, to understand what implant treatment is, it is necessary to be informed about many important details, from how implant treatment is performed to who can undergo it.
Differences Between Implant Treatment and Other Dental Treatments

To understand what implant treatment is, you need to know how it differs from other dental treatments. Implant treatment differs from other dental treatments in many ways, from how it is performed to the results obtained. The differences between implant treatment and other dental treatments can be explained in a few points.
Providing a Permanent Result Very Close to a Natural Tooth

Implants are a very successful imitation of natural tooth roots. Therefore, thanks to implants, the main material used in implant treatments, a permanent result very close to a natural tooth is achieved, unlike other dental treatments. Thanks to high-quality prostheses tailored to the individual, implant treatment results can be so aesthetic and functional that they are almost indistinguishable from natural teeth.
Helps Preserve the Jawbone

There are several main reasons why jawbone resorption occurs in the elderly and especially in individuals without teeth. The main reasons are the deactivation of the jawbone due to the lack of energy transmission, such as chewing force, and the onset of bone loss, which is negatively affected by dentures, also known as false teeth. However, this is not the case with implant treatment, and with the advantages of implants, it is even possible to preserve the jawbone in old age. For all these reasons, implant treatment is a different application from treatments such as denture treatment, with its jawbone protection effect.
Highly Advantageous in Terms of Functionality and Comfort

Implant treatment is a very different option from other dental treatments according to many dentists because it is much more advantageous in terms of functionality and comfort. There are quite a few limited methods that can be used in the face of tooth loss, and among these methods, implant treatment is the most advantageous option. For example, while options such as dentures involve the use of a removable prosthesis that can be uncomfortable in various ways, the prosthetic teeth you will have as a result of implant treatment are fixed and do not cause any discomfort in terms of functionality.
Who is Implant Treatment Suitable For?

When you visit any healthcare facility, such as an implant clinic in Istanbul, you will not start implant treatment immediately. In order for an individual to benefit from implant treatment, it must first be determined whether they are suitable for this treatment. Patient profiles who can benefit from implant treatment can be explained under several headings.
For Patients with a Single Missing Tooth

Although many people think that implant treatment can only be performed on individuals who have lost multiple teeth or all of their teeth, this is not actually true. Implant placement procedures can also be performed for a single tooth, and patients with a single tooth loss can benefit from functional and reliable implant treatments just like individuals who have lost most or all of their teeth.
Individuals Experiencing Complete Tooth Loss and Multiple Tooth Loss

Implant treatment is most suitable for patients who are completely toothless or have lost most of their teeth. Complete tooth loss or multiple tooth loss can occur for many different reasons. From trauma to poor oral hygiene, improper dental treatments to various health problems, many different situations can cause individuals to lose multiple teeth or all of their teeth. In this case, resorting to implant treatment and going through the stages of implant treatment can provide you with prosthetic teeth that you can use securely for a lifetime.
Implant Treatment Application Process

How implant treatment is performed varies depending on multiple factors. Many different factors, from the technique to be used in implant treatment to the patient’s needs, determine how the implant treatment application process will proceed. For example, while the process for all-on-four implant treatment involves placing implants in multiple locations, the situation is different for single implant treatments.

The first step in the implant treatment process is usually a comprehensive examination and consultation. A comprehensive oral examination allows the dentist to obtain information on important issues such as the individual’s overall oral health. In addition, as a result of the consultation and panoramic imaging methods, a suitable implant treatment plan can be prepared for the patient, and the actual implant treatment stages can begin.
Placing the Implant in the Jawbone

One of the most important and perhaps the main steps in the implant treatment process is placing the implant in the jawbone. Strong local anesthesia is usually used when placing the implant in the jawbone because the goal is to treat the individual without causing any pain. After local anesthesia, the implant is placed in the jawbone using the correct angles and techniques according to the patient’s wishes and needs.
Preparation and Fitting of the Prosthetic Superstructure

In implant treatment, after the implant or implants are placed in the jawbone, the prosthetic superstructure is prepared while the implants fuse with the jawbone. Prostheses, which are the superstructure of the implant, consist of an artificial tooth or teeth, thus meeting both the aesthetic demands and medical needs of the patient. For the prosthetic superstructure to be placed, the implants must adapt to the jawbone, or in other words, fuse, but temporary prostheses can be used during this time to avoid inconveniencing the patient. This is why treatments using innovative and temporary prostheses are referred to as one-day implant treatment. At this stage, implant treatment may be accompanied by antibiotic use, as it may be necessary to prevent any infection from occurring.
Are Implant Treatment Prices Very High?

According to a common belief among the public, implant treatment prices are considered to be very high, and the cost of implant teeth is thought to be financially prohibitive. However, contrary to popular belief, the cost of implant teeth and the total implant treatment prices are not very high. The first factor affecting the implant price range is where the procedure will be performed.

If the clinic is in an area where clinic rental fees are high, such as an implant clinic in Istanbul, the price of treatment provided by specialist implant dentists may also be high. Healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the implant clinic Istanbul options, provide services with specialist implant dentists, taking into account an affordable implant price range.

For all these reasons, instead of thinking that implant treatment prices are extremely high, you should choose healthcare clinics that offer services at the most affordable implant price range possible with specialist implant dentists. This way, you can enjoy the advantages of affordable, reliable, and comprehensive treatment with specialist implant dentists.
Types of Implants and Their Uses

Although many people think there is only one type of implant, this is not actually the case. Implants, which are the main structure of implant treatment, can be categorized according to their types, qualities, features, advantages, and uses. However, the most preferred types of implants can be explained under a few main headings. There are several factors that determine the cost of dental implants and the total price of implant treatment.
Titanium Implants and Their Features

Titanium implants, the most preferred type of implant, have many different features. Titanium is a biocompatible material, meaning it is compatible with the human body. Therefore, the possibility of titanium implants causing adverse situations such as rejection by the body or allergic reactions is close to zero. For this reason, when it comes to implant treatment recommendations, many experts argue that titanium implants should be preferred due to their biocompatibility.
Zirconium Implants and Their Advantages

Zirconium implants are also a frequently preferred type of implant in implant treatment and offer many advantages. Some individuals may experience sensitivity to the metals contained in titanium implants. Zirconium implants offer an advantageous treatment option for these individuals in particular, both due to their durability and the fact that they do not contain metal.
What Are the Advantages of Implant Treatment?

Implant treatment is advantageous in many ways. Implant treatments offered reliably, comprehensively, and tailored to the individual at clinics such as Dentaliva, which is among the healthcare institutions offering implant treatment in Istanbul, provide many advantages, from giving individuals a natural appearance to preserving the jawbone. The advantages of implant treatment can be summarized under several headings.
Natural Appearance and Chewing Comfort

All on four implant treatment and almost all other implant treatments offer advantageous results in terms of both appearance and comfort. Tooth loss, especially when all or most of the teeth are lost, can cause the individual to look much older and less aesthetically pleasing. In addition, individuals without teeth cannot chew food and may experience discomfort as well as digestive system problems. Implant treatment solves both of these problems, providing the individual with an aesthetic and natural appearance as well as chewing comfort. However, to achieve this, it is necessary to choose reliable options such as Dentaliva from among the options in any region or implant clinics in Istanbul.
Helps Protect the Jawbone

Although many people are unaware, tooth loss causes the jawbone to deteriorate over time and results in a significant loss of jawbone density. The main reason for this is that after tooth loss, the jawbone is used less, and bone density is lost due to the absence of teeth attached to the bone. Implant treatment can stop jawbone deterioration and even improve jawbone density.
Things to Consider After Implant Treatment

In the first few days after implant treatment, and even longer if possible, until the implants, which are placed as artificial tooth roots, fuse with the jawbone, it is necessary to be careful in many areas, from consuming very hard foods to paying attention to daily oral care. What needs to be considered after implant treatment, both in the early and long term, can be explained under several headings.
Regular Oral Hygiene and Daily Care

After implant treatment, it is necessary to maintain regular oral hygiene both during the early healing period, i.e., the process during which the implants adapt to the jawbone, and in the long term, and especially not to neglect daily oral care. In the first few hours or, depending on the situation, the first few days after the implant is placed, it is necessary to avoid very hard products and movements in order to maintain oral hygiene. In addition, in order to maintain intensive oral hygiene, it is necessary to perform thorough teeth and general oral cleaning with high-quality dental care products suitable for implants and, consequently, implant-supported prostheses, after obtaining approval from your dentist.
The Importance of Routine Dental Checkups

Although many people are unaware of this, you need to have routine dental checkups even if you do not have any dental problems. This is especially true if you have undergone a sensitive treatment such as implant treatment; you should not skip dental check-ups for the rest of your life after this treatment. Dental check-ups can prevent any adverse situations that may occur after implant treatment or treat them at an early stage. In addition to all this, you can keep your overall oral health under control in the safest way possible by undergoing dental check-ups.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long after tooth extraction is implant treatment performed?

How long after tooth extraction implant treatment is performed may vary depending on the situation. In order to obtain the most effective results from any treatment, including implant treatment, treatments need to be tailored to the individual according to the situation. However, in general, the vast majority of dentists recommend waiting at least a few months after tooth extraction before undergoing implant treatment. During this time, the gums heal and the risk of complications in the area decreases, making it possible to perform implant treatment more safely.
How much does implant treatment cost?

Implant treatment prices are determined based on multiple factors. The implant price range is shaped by many different factors, from the region where the treatment will be performed to the capabilities of the healthcare facility. In addition, the patient’s choices and requests also determine the implant treatment price range. For example, the cost of implant teeth, or in other words, the price of the prosthetic teeth that will be used as the superstructure of the implants, may vary depending on which brand the patient chooses.
How long does implant treatment take?

The duration of implant treatment is determined by several factors. The main factors that determine how long any treatment, including implant treatment, will take are the patient’s medical needs, the experience of the dentist performing the treatment, and the patient’s requests. However, in general, placing an implant for a single tooth is a procedure that takes approximately 40-60 minutes. Placing a temporary prosthesis on top of the implant is done on the same day in options that offer one-day implant treatment, such as all on four implant treatment, but it may be necessary to wait at least 2-3 months before the permanent implant can be placed.
Does implant treatment cause pain?

Many people think that implant treatment is a very painful procedure. However, with the developments in dentistry today, innovative methods, and successful interventions by dentists, implant treatment has become less painful than it was in the past. In implant treatments, local anesthesia is used during surgical interventions such as implant placement to ensure that the individual does not experience any pain. After the effects of local anesthesia wear off, you may feel some discomfort due to minimal damage in the area. You can control this pain with medication recommended by your dentist.
Can implant treatment be performed while using alcohol?

Implant treatment is not performed while using alcohol. When alcohol consumption has certain negative effects on general health and, in particular, when there are certain health problems related to alcohol consumption, individuals may not be considered suitable candidates for implant treatment. In addition, even for individuals who are considered suitable, it is recommended that they stop drinking alcohol at least a few days before implant treatment and refrain from drinking alcohol during the early recovery period of a few days after implant treatment.
How should nutrition be after implant treatment?

Nutrition after implant treatment depends on the process. In the first few days after a sensitive dental treatment such as implant treatment, it is necessary to avoid eating very hot, cold, or hard foods and to choose foods and drinks that are not uncomfortable in terms of both temperature and hardness. In the long term, you can start eating hard foods according to your doctor’s recommendations and approval. However, if you are using a temporary prosthesis, you may need to avoid very hard foods until complete healing occurs, depending on the situation.

title: Subperiostal Implant | Dentaliva Dental Clinic

blocks.text: Tooth loss is a problem that can lead to many different issues. That is why individuals resort to many different treatment methods to compensate for tooth loss. Innovative methods such as implant treatments and subperiostal implants, which allow for two implant-supported dentures, offer individuals advantageous results in many ways. That is why many people prefer subperiosteal implant treatment, gaining advantages in different areas.

To ensure that subperiosteal implant treatment is performed in the most accurate and advantageous way, you must make the right choice of subperiosteal implant clinic. Thanks to reliable healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the subperiosteal clinic Istanbul options, you can receive comprehensive services with affordable advanced implant technique fees and innovative interventions. In addition to all this, if you want to learn more about the subperiosteal implant treatment process, you need to learn details such as who subperiosteal implants are suitable for.
What is a Subperiosteal Implant and How Does it Differ from Other Implants?

Subperiosteal implants are a highly innovative implant treatment method. Many people who cannot benefit from classic implant treatments or more comprehensive methods such as all-on-four implant treatment prefer subperiosteal implants. Subperiosteal implants differ from other implants in many ways.

The biggest difference between subperiosteal implants and other implants is that they are placed in the area between the bone and the gum, not inside the bone. Under normal circumstances, implant treatments require the placement of implants, also known as artificial tooth roots, into the bone. However, this is not the case for subperiosteal implants. Therefore, subperiosteal implants differ from other implant treatments in that they allow patients who have lost most of their bone density and cannot benefit from treatments such as all-on-4 to use fixed prostheses.
Who is a Subperiosteal Implant Suitable For?

Subperiosteal implants are a type of implant that can be considered suitable for many different patient profiles. In particular, specialist subperiosteal dentists often recommend subperiosteal implants for patients with advanced bone loss who still wish to use fixed prostheses. The patient profiles that subperiosteal implant treatment is suitable for can be summarized under several headings.
Patients with Severe Bone Loss

The patient profile most suited to subperiostal implants is individuals with severe bone loss. Specialist subperiosteal dentists recommend subperiosteal implant treatment to patients with advanced bone loss, rather than methods such as all-on-four or classic implant treatment, because this treatment does not involve placing implants in the jawbone, so advanced bone loss is not an issue. Patients with advanced bone loss can also benefit from subperiosteal implant treatment at healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the subperiosteal clinic Istanbul options and offers professional healthcare services.
Individuals Not Suitable for the Classic Implant Method

Some individuals cannot benefit from classic implant treatments due to reasons such as low jawbone density or having a jawbone that is too low to allow for classic implant treatments. In such cases, specialist subperiosteal physicians can step in to ensure that the individual benefits from subperiosteal implant treatment in a way that is suitable for them.
Those Seeking a Fixed and Practical Prosthesis Solution

Subperiosteal implant treatment is also suitable for individuals seeking a fixed and practical prosthesis solution. Options such as dentures, also known as removable dentures, can lead to many negative situations, from spoiling the individual’s overall oral appearance to negatively affecting functions such as chewing and speaking. Subperiostal implant treatment, on the other hand, utilizes methods such as 2 implant-supported dentures, providing a solution for individuals who want to use a fixed and practical prosthesis.
How is Subperiostal Implant Treatment Performed?

How subperiostal implant treatment is performed may vary depending on the situation. As with any treatment, there is a standard procedure for subperiostal implant treatments. However, since the main goal of these types of treatments is to offer solutions that are suitable and personalized for the patient, how the treatment is performed can be tailored to the patient’s wishes and needs. The steps involved in subperiosteal implant treatment, which falls under the scope of dental surgery, can be summarized under several headings.
Detailed Evaluation and Design

As with any implant treatment, including subperiosteal treatment, a detailed evaluation is necessary first. This evaluation is crucial and necessary to determine whether the individual is suitable for subperiosteal implant use. Once it is determined that the individual is suitable for subperiosteal implant use, a personalized design is created based on the individual’s choices, taking into account subperiosteal implant prices and specifically the cost of bone-supported implants. The treatment planning is completed along with the design process. After treatment planning and the design process, the implant placement stage begins.
Implant Placement Stage

Local anesthesia methods are generally used during the subperiostal implant placement stage. Local anesthesia methods prevent individuals from feeling any pain or discomfort during the implant placement procedure. The subperiosteal implant is placed under the gum tissue so that it will be in contact with the bone but not fully embedded in it. After this, the superstructures that will carry the dental prosthesis are also removed from inside the gum tissue.
Healing and Prosthesis Application

After the subperiosteal implant is placed, the gums and surrounding tissues are allowed to heal. Why is Endodontics/Root Canal Treatment Performed?

There are multiple situations that may necessitate endodontic treatment, or more accurately, root canal treatment. The main goal of root canal treatment is to clean and disinfect the pulp structure and canals, which are the innermost structures of the tooth. The situations that necessitate root canal treatment can be summarized in a few points.

Tooth decay is one of the most common reasons for root canal treatment. Although individuals may view tooth decay as a minor and superficial problem, it is actually a significant issue that can lead to tooth loss and deterioration of overall oral health or general health. Dental decay that is not treated early on and spreads extensively can cause significant and negative problems, requiring treatment by a dentist. In dental decay, not only the surface of the tooth but also the internal tissues can be damaged. In particular, decay that reaches the pulp region can cause bacteria to lead to pulpitis. In such cases, it is necessary to consult an endodontist and undergo effective root canal treatment. Effective treatment is provided by cleaning the decay on the outer parts of the tooth before root canal treatment and the bacteria in the inner structures of the tooth during root canal treatment.

Although it may sound surprising, an impact to the tooth can also lead to the need for root canal treatment. Sometimes, even if the impact on the tooth does not cause an outwardly visible problem, it can cause damage to the inner parts of the tooth. Especially when there is damage to the pulp tissue and the canals in this area, root canal treatment is necessary to protect the blood flow and overall health of the tooth. Failure to perform root canal treatment in such cases can lead to the tooth losing its vitality completely in the long term and, consequently, to tooth loss. For all these reasons, if you have suffered an impact to your mouth and especially to a tooth or teeth, you should make an endodontics appointment to have the situation checked by an endodontist.
Incorrect Dental Treatments

Another situation that necessitates root canal treatment is improper dental treatment. In particular, performing highly complex and extensive dental treatments using incorrect methods or in a repetitive manner can cause pressure and damage to the pulp, as well as to all structures of the tooth. For all these reasons, some individuals may require root canal treatment as a result of incorrect interventions. Therefore, if you have undergone unhealthy dental treatment or frequent dental treatment, you may need to make an appointment for endodontic root canal treatment.
Why Choose Root Canal Treatment Over Tooth Extraction?

Many people may think that tooth extraction is a logical and comfortable option in various situations, such as advanced tooth decay or tooth inflammation. However, this thinking is not valid in every situation and is a major misconception in some cases. Many dentists recommend preserving natural teeth whenever possible because, although treatments such as implants offer effective results, the comfort of using natural teeth is on a completely different level.

In addition to all this, it is recommended that individuals, especially young people, preserve their natural teeth with treatments such as root canal therapy rather than opting for procedures like prosthetic teeth following tooth extraction, because choosing tooth extraction at a young age is illogical in many ways. The procedures performed during root canal treatment stages can ensure that your tooth or teeth become healthy enough to last a lifetime. For all these reasons, instead of thinking that the first and only option in cases such as damage to the dental pulp is to have the tooth extracted, you need to consult an endodontist by making an endodontics appointment.
Painless and Comfortable Root Canal Treatment with Modern Technologies

Another specific reason why root canal treatment is a logical choice over tooth extraction is that modern technologies allow for painless and comfortable root canal treatment. Healthcare facilities offering the services of endodontists who are professionals in dental treatments, such as Dentaliva, can provide individuals with highly effective and comfortable treatment services. For example, thanks to applications such as temporary filling in root canal treatment, a method used by endodontists to effectively treat teeth in sessions, comprehensive, reliable, and comfortable treatment can be provided. For all these reasons, root canal treatment should not be seen as a method that is less effective, painful, and unreliable than tooth extraction in all cases.
Is Root Canal Treatment Very Expensive?

When root canal treatment is mentioned, the first questions that come to mind are “Is root canal treatment very expensive?” and “How much does root canal treatment cost?” regarding root canal treatment fees. The question “How much does root canal treatment cost?” is particularly important for Turkish patients. Contrary to popular belief, root canal treatments are not extremely expensive at clinics such as Dentaliva, which is among the endodontic specialist clinic Istanbul options. For example, the root canal specialist not unnecessarily prolonging the root canal treatment and performing quick procedures can ensure that services are provided at root canal fees that are not financially devastating, within a reasonable root canal price range.
How is Endodontics/Root Canal Treatment Performed?

Endodontic treatment, or more accurately, root canal treatment, is a complex procedure. Therefore, root canal treatment must be performed in several steps. The stages of root canal treatment can be addressed under several headings.
Comprehensive Examination and Accurate Diagnosis Before Treatment

In order for any treatment, including root canal treatment, to be performed correctly, a comprehensive examination must be carried out before treatment. This enables an accurate diagnosis to be made and methods suitable for the individual to be determined. Professional endodontists, who can be called specialist root canal doctors, correctly diagnose the dental problem experienced by the individual during the examination prior to root canal treatment and, accordingly, understand whether the individual really needs root canal treatment. If it is determined that the individual needs root canal treatment, an appropriate plan can be made for the individual, and the actual treatment stages can be started with effective and personalized methods.
Root Canal Treatment Procedure

In the main stage of the root canal treatment procedure, the tooth is first numbed using local anesthesia methods, and procedures such as decay removal are performed as needed. After these procedures, the pulp tissue is accessed and removed. The canals in the area are cleaned with powerful disinfectants and then filled with root canal-appropriate filling materials. Following these steps, dental crowns or fillings may be applied to the tooth, depending on the situation and the individual’s preferences.
Innovative Devices and Techniques Used in Root Canal Treatment

Although root canal treatment has been engraved in many people’s minds as a very difficult and painful method in the past, thanks to the innovative devices and techniques used in root canal treatment today, root canal treatment has become much more comfortable and easier. Especially with root canal treatments performed using innovative medical devices such as apex locators, in light of imaging methods such as digital dental X-rays, comfortable and effective results can be achieved in a short time.
Why Does Root Canal Treatment Fail?

There are many different situations that can cause root canal treatments to fail. These situations mainly include performing root canal treatment on a tooth that cannot be saved and performing incorrect interventions due to choosing the wrong healthcare facility for root canal treatment. In both cases, the failure of root canal treatment begins to manifest itself with symptoms of failed root canal treatment, such as severe pain, discoloration of the tooth, sensitivity, and swelling in the tooth area. The reasons for root canal failure can be explained in more detail under several headings.
Performing Root Canal Treatment on a Tooth That Cannot Be Saved

In many cases, root canal treatment is a much more logical and beneficial option than alternatives such as tooth extraction. However, in some cases, such as when decay has completely destroyed the tooth and the tooth is beyond saving, performing root canal treatment on the tooth will inevitably lead to the failure of the root canal treatment.

## Why is Endodontics/Root Canal Treatment Performed?

There are multiple situations that may necessitate endodontic treatment, or more accurately, root canal treatment. The main goal of root canal treatment is to clean and disinfect the pulp structure and canals, which are the innermost structures of the tooth. The situations that necessitate root canal treatment can be summarized in a few points.

Tooth decay is one of the most common reasons for root canal treatment. Although individuals may view tooth decay as a minor and superficial problem, it is actually a significant issue that can lead to tooth loss and deterioration of overall oral health or general health. Dental decay that is not treated early on and spreads extensively can cause significant and negative problems, requiring treatment by a dentist. In dental decay, not only the surface of the tooth but also the internal tissues can be damaged. In particular, decay that reaches the pulp region can cause bacteria to lead to pulpitis. In such cases, it is necessary to consult an endodontist and undergo effective root canal treatment. Effective treatment is provided by cleaning the decay on the outer parts of the tooth before root canal treatment and the bacteria in the inner structures of the tooth during root canal treatment.

Although it may sound surprising, an impact to the tooth can also lead to the need for root canal treatment. Sometimes, even if the impact on the tooth does not cause an outwardly visible problem, it can cause damage to the inner parts of the tooth. Especially when there is damage to the pulp tissue and the canals in this area, root canal treatment is necessary to protect the blood flow and overall health of the tooth. Failure to perform root canal treatment in such cases can lead to the tooth losing its vitality completely in the long term and, consequently, to tooth loss. For all these reasons, if you have suffered an impact to your mouth and especially to a tooth or teeth, you should make an endodontics appointment to have the situation checked by an endodontist.
Incorrect Dental Treatments

Another situation that necessitates root canal treatment is improper dental treatment. In particular, performing highly complex and extensive dental treatments using incorrect methods or in a repetitive manner can cause pressure and damage to the pulp, as well as to all structures of the tooth. For all these reasons, some individuals may require root canal treatment as a result of incorrect interventions. Therefore, if you have undergone unhealthy dental treatment or frequent dental treatment, you may need to make an appointment for endodontic root canal treatment.
## Why Choose Root Canal Treatment Over Tooth Extraction?

Many people may think that tooth extraction is a logical and comfortable option in various situations, such as advanced tooth decay or tooth inflammation. However, this thinking is not valid in every situation and is a major misconception in some cases. Many dentists recommend preserving natural teeth whenever possible because, although treatments such as implants offer effective results, the comfort of using natural teeth is on a completely different level.

In addition to all this, it is recommended that individuals, especially young people, preserve their natural teeth with treatments such as root canal therapy rather than opting for procedures like prosthetic teeth following tooth extraction, because choosing tooth extraction at a young age is illogical in many ways. The procedures performed during root canal treatment stages can ensure that your tooth or teeth become healthy enough to last a lifetime. For all these reasons, instead of thinking that the first and only option in cases such as damage to the dental pulp is to have the tooth extracted, you need to consult an endodontist by making an endodontics appointment.
### Painless and Comfortable Root Canal Treatment with Modern Technologies

Another specific reason why root canal treatment is a logical choice over tooth extraction is that modern technologies allow for painless and comfortable root canal treatment. Healthcare facilities offering the services of endodontists who are professionals in dental treatments, such as Dentaliva, can provide individuals with highly effective and comfortable treatment services. For example, thanks to applications such as temporary filling in root canal treatment, a method used by endodontists to effectively treat teeth in sessions, comprehensive, reliable, and comfortable treatment can be provided. For all these reasons, root canal treatment should not be seen as a method that is less effective, painful, and unreliable than tooth extraction in all cases.
## Is Root Canal Treatment Very Expensive?

When root canal treatment is mentioned, the first questions that come to mind are “Is root canal treatment very expensive?” and “How much does root canal treatment cost?” regarding root canal treatment fees. The question “How much does root canal treatment cost?” is particularly important for Turkish patients. Contrary to popular belief, root canal treatments are not extremely expensive at clinics such as Dentaliva, which is among the endodontic specialist clinic Istanbul options. Healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the endodontic specialist clinic Istanbul options, take care to ensure that the total root canal treatment fees are at an appropriate level when determining the root canal treatment price range. For example, the root canal specialist not unnecessarily prolonging the root canal treatment and performing quick procedures can ensure that services are provided at root canal fees that are not financially devastating, within a reasonable root canal price range.
## How is Endodontics/Root Canal Treatment Performed?

Endodontic treatment, or more accurately, root canal treatment, is a complex procedure. Therefore, root canal treatment must be performed in several steps. The stages of root canal treatment can be addressed under several headings.
### Comprehensive Examination and Accurate Diagnosis Before Treatment

In order for any treatment, including root canal treatment, to be performed correctly, a comprehensive examination must be carried out before treatment. This enables an accurate diagnosis to be made and methods suitable for the individual to be determined. Professional endodontists, who can be called specialist root canal doctors, correctly diagnose the dental problem experienced by the individual during the examination prior to root canal treatment and, accordingly, understand whether the individual really needs root canal treatment. If it is determined that the individual needs root canal treatment, an appropriate plan can be made for the individual, and the actual treatment stages can be started with effective and personalized methods.
### Root Canal Treatment Procedure

In the main stage of the root canal treatment procedure, the tooth is first numbed using local anesthesia methods, and procedures such as decay removal are performed as needed. After these procedures, the pulp tissue is accessed and removed. The canals in the area are cleaned with powerful disinfectants and then filled with root canal-appropriate filling materials. Following these steps, dental crowns or fillings may be applied to the tooth, depending on the situation and the individual’s preferences.
### Innovative Devices and Techniques Used in Root Canal Treatment

Although root canal treatment has been engraved in many people’s minds as a very difficult and painful method in the past, thanks to the innovative devices and techniques used in root canal treatment today, root canal treatment has become much more comfortable and easier. blocks.text: Prosthetic Dental Treatment

Tooth loss is a problem that can occur due to many different issues. Many people lose teeth or teeth for various reasons, both at a very young age and in later years. The loss of teeth can lead to many different and serious risks, ranging from a deterioration in a person’s overall appearance to a negative impact on their speech functions, digestive problems due to the loss of chewing function, and even jawbone erosion. For all these reasons, denture treatment is used in the field of dentistry.

Dental prosthesis treatment, as the name suggests, is performed with the aim of providing individuals with artificial teeth that closely resemble real teeth in terms of both functionality and appearance. Dental prosthesis models differ from each other due to factors such as brands and the materials they are made of. In addition, when it comes to types of dental prostheses, one of the most important factors is which dental prosthesis treatment is preferred. Since each individual’s expectations and medical needs regarding dental prostheses may differ, specialist prosthetic dentists may recommend different methods to individuals.

Istanbul is a city where you will find many options for prosthetic tooth treatment because healthcare services are highly developed in the city. Choosing healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the prosthetic clinics in Istanbul, helps you gain advantages in many different ways. If you want to receive affordable services at reasonable prosthetic tooth prices and quickly request a prosthetic tooth treatment appointment, you can contact us.
Who Can Benefit from Prosthetic Tooth Treatment?

Prosthetic tooth treatments are suitable for many different patients. The comprehensive nature of denture treatments makes them suitable for different patient profiles. Individuals who want to have permanent teeth by covering expenses such as removable denture costs are particularly suitable for denture treatment. In fact, the patient profiles treated by dentures can be grouped under a single heading: those seeking a permanent solution to missing teeth.
Those Seeking a Permanent Solution to Missing Teeth

Dental prosthesis treatment is, of course, primarily a suitable treatment for those seeking a permanent solution to missing teeth. Although many people may not be aware of it, individuals of all ages can lose their teeth due to various reasons. Tooth loss is a negative situation that affects individuals’ comfort, overall health, and appearance. Therefore, individuals seeking a permanent solution to missing teeth can make the right choice for themselves, considering costs such as the cost of implant-supported dentures, and find a permanent solution to their missing teeth problem.
What Are the Types of Dentures?

Contrary to popular belief, denture treatment is not performed in a standard way. The choices made regarding types of dentures determine how the denture treatment will be performed. Dentures can be classified in terms of denture materials and types. Types of dentures can be explained in detail under several headings.
Fixed Denture Applications (Bridge and Crown)

When it comes to denture treatment, fixed denture applications are among the most preferred options. Fixed denture applications can be performed in two different ways: bridges and crowns. As the name suggests, a bridge application is performed when not all teeth have been lost, using the remaining teeth as bridge abutments. In a crown application, teeth that are about to be lost are covered to save them and prevent tooth loss.
Removable Dentures (Full Dentures)

Another method used in prosthetic dentistry is total dentures, commonly known as false teeth. This method, which offers greater convenience in denture care compared to other methods and is also easier from a medical procedure perspective, is particularly suitable for patients who have lost a large portion of their jawbone density and wish to avoid complex medical procedures for various reasons. Because dentures are completely removable, they are taken out during sleep and may come out of the mouth while performing functions such as speaking. For this reason, many prosthodontists view total dentures as a last resort and do not recommend them very often.
Fixed Implant-Supported Dentures

Denture treatment Another one of the most preferred methods is fixed implant-supported dentures. Fixed implant-supported dentures offer ideal denture treatment for individuals who want to achieve the most comfortable results from denture treatment. Since implants are like artificial tooth roots, they can remain in the jawbone for almost a lifetime. The dentures attached to the implants are also fixed, ensuring comfortable use. However, fixed implant-supported dentures can slightly increase the cost of implant-supported dentures because they are made of high-quality materials and are very labor-intensive to manufacture. Nevertheless, many people, especially younger patients, accept the cost of implant-supported dentures and reap the long-term benefits.
Removable Prostheses on Implants

Prosthesis clinic Istanbul options, including Dentaliva, offer removable prostheses on implants as an option for prosthetic tooth treatment. In healthcare institutions that are among the professional prosthesis clinic Istanbul options, the implants are fixed, but the prostheses are removable in removable prosthesis treatment on implants. This can reduce the cost of implant-supported dentures because the cost of removable dentures is much more affordable than some denture options.
How is Denture Treatment Performed?

How denture treatments are performed may vary depending on the situation. Denture treatments are a type of treatment that each individual benefits from with different needs and expectations. Therefore, just like denture treatment prices, the way denture treatment is performed may vary depending on the situation. However, in general, denture treatments are performed in several steps. These steps can be explained under several headings.
Initial Examination and Comprehensive Analysis

As with many treatments, denture treatments begin with a comprehensive examination and analysis. During the comprehensive examination, the specialist prosthodontist obtains information on many important issues, ranging from the individual’s general oral and dental health to the denture models that could potentially be used. The comprehensive examination, which is the first step in prosthetic dentistry treatment, is reinforced by methods such as interviews and imaging techniques to prepare a treatment plan suitable for the patient.
Preparation and Application in the Laboratory Environment

Almost all prosthetic dentistry treatments require a preparation phase in the laboratory environment. In the laboratory environment, the procedure is performed taking into account factors such as denture care, comfortable use, and denture prices. The resulting prosthesis is placed in the mouth according to the preferred denture treatment method. Of course, this placement procedure is first performed by a specialist prosthodontist for both removable and fixed prostheses.
Advantages of Prosthetic Dentistry

Prosthetic dentistry is a treatment that offers many different advantages. The advantages of benefiting from prosthetic tooth treatment, and especially from prosthetic tooth treatments offered by specialist healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the professional prosthetic clinics in Istanbul, can be explained under several headings.
Natural Appearance and Solid Chewing Comfort

The biggest advantage offered by prosthetic tooth treatment is the provision of a natural appearance and chewing comfort. In addition, individuals who choose high-quality materials, especially considering denture prices, can achieve solid chewing comfort with their high-quality dentures.
Aesthetic Smile and Balance in Facial Features

Missing teeth can cause an aged and unaesthetic appearance, especially in the lower face and the general facial area. Furthermore, it is obviously not possible for individuals without teeth to chew anything. With denture treatment, not only is a natural tooth appearance provided, but the overall appearance is also rejuvenated and made more aesthetic. In particular, it becomes possible to achieve a balanced or, more accurately, a proportional appearance in the lower face area.
Materials Used in Denture Treatment

There are many different materials used in denture treatment. The materials to be used in such treatments depend on the patient’s choices, taking into account issues such as the cost of removable dentures or denture prices. An experienced denture specialist aims to provide the patient with advantages in financial matters, such as the cost of removable dentures, and to offer comprehensive solutions by recommending suitable and high-quality materials to the patient.
Care Recommendations After Denture Treatment

Denture care is not as complicated or costly as it may seem. Individuals with dentures need to pay attention to their general oral and dental health, just like individuals who use their own natural teeth. Otherwise, treatments such as crowns or root canal treatment for dentures may become necessary. Denture cleaning should be done using high-quality products recommended by dentists rather than natural methods. In addition, procedures such as denture whitening can be performed over time using at-home or in-office teeth whitening methods to ensure that dentures are as aesthetic and well-maintained as possible.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does denture treatment cost?

Dental prosthesis treatment prices are determined based on multiple factors. Therefore, it would not be accurate to provide a specific price for any dental prosthesis treatment. The treatment method used in prosthetic tooth treatment, the quality of the prosthesis in question, the patient’s decisions regarding material selection, and the patient’s medical needs ensure that the price of prosthetic tooth treatment is calculated accurately and correctly. For this reason, if you want to obtain clear information about the prices of prosthetic tooth treatment, you can consult reliable healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva.
Is prosthetic tooth treatment a prosthesis?

Prosthetic dental treatment is denture treatment. In healthcare, a treatment can be referred to by more than one name. Denture treatment, one of these treatments, is also referred to as prosthetic dental treatment. Within the scope of prosthetic dental treatment, highly safe and effective methods are used to address tooth loss in individuals. Many different types of treatment, from implant treatments to total denture applications, fall under the scope of prosthetic dental treatment. Prosthetic dentistry treatments should be performed at professional and reliable healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva.
How long do dentures last?

The lifespan of dentures can vary depending on the situation. There are many different types of dentures that fall under the scope of prosthetic dentistry. There are many different types of dentures, ranging from fixed dentures on implants to removable dentures, or total dentures, as they are medically known, and the lifespan of each type may differ. In addition, factors such as the individual’s level of care for their dentures and seeking help from reliable healthcare institutions for procedures such as denture whitening also affect the lifespan of dentures. While the average lifespan of removable dentures is around 5-6 years, the lifespan of fixed implant-supported dentures is around 20-25 years.
Is denture treatment painful?

Denture treatment is not as painful as people think. Individuals who need denture treatment have usually lost more than one tooth and experienced pain and discomfort when losing these teeth, regardless of the cause. These individuals can benefit from painless denture treatments called total dentures. In addition, although there is minimal pain in treatments such as fixed prosthetic treatment on implants, this pain can be controlled with the use of painkillers.
How is denture treatment care performed?

How denture treatment is maintained may vary depending on the situation. Dentures, and especially the materials used on the front surface of these dentures, can differ from one another, so the maintenance recommendations given to individuals may also vary depending on the situation. For example, a care product that is quite safe for one type of prosthesis material may damage another type of prosthesis. Therefore, when it comes to denture care, you should follow the recommendations of the dentist who performed your prosthetic treatment.
How long does denture treatment take?

The duration of denture treatment may vary depending on the situation because there are many types of dentures. Each type of dental prosthesis can be placed with different treatment durations. However, certain methods are used to achieve results as quickly as possible in dental prosthesis treatments. In addition, temporary prostheses can be fitted during the dental prosthesis treatment period to prevent the patient from being negatively affected by tooth loss, thereby avoiding any inconvenience during treatment.

### How long do dentures last?

The lifespan of dentures can vary depending on the situation. There are many different types of dentures that fall under the scope of prosthetic dentistry. There are many different types of dentures, ranging from fixed dentures on implants to removable dentures, or total dentures, as they are medically known, and the lifespan of each type may differ. In addition, factors such as the individual’s level of care for their dentures and seeking help from reliable healthcare institutions for procedures such as denture whitening also affect the lifespan of dentures. While the average lifespan of removable dentures is around 5-6 years, the lifespan of fixed implant-supported dentures is around 20-25 years.
### Is denture treatment painful?

Denture treatment is not as painful as people think. Individuals who need denture treatment have usually lost more than one tooth and experienced pain and discomfort when losing these teeth, regardless of the cause. These individuals can benefit from painless denture treatments called total dentures. In addition, although there is minimal pain in treatments such as fixed prosthetic treatment on implants, this pain can be controlled with the use of painkillers.
### How is denture treatment care performed?

How denture treatment is maintained may vary depending on the situation. Dentures, and especially the materials used on the front surface of these dentures, can differ from one another, so the maintenance recommendations given to individuals may also vary depending on the situation. For example, a care product that is quite safe for one type of prosthesis material may damage another type of prosthesis. Therefore, when it comes to denture care, you should follow the recommendations of the dentist who performed your prosthetic treatment.
### How long does denture treatment take?

The duration of denture treatment may vary depending on the situation because there are many types of dentures. Each type of dental prosthesis can be placed with different treatment durations. However, certain methods are used to achieve results as quickly as possible in dental prosthesis treatments. In addition, temporary prostheses can be fitted during the dental prosthesis treatment period to prevent the patient from being negatively affected by tooth loss, thereby avoiding any inconvenience during treatment.

A pediatric dentist, or more precisely a specialist in pediatric dentistry, after graduating from the faculty of dentistry, obtains a specialization in the field of pediatric dentistry and can perform many procedures, such as root canal treatment in children. The importance and goals of pediatric dentistry

Pediatric dentistry is, unfortunately, a field whose importance is not fully understood and which is overlooked by many people. The main reason for this is that check-ups for children carried out as part of pediatric dentistry or treatment tailored to children’s needs seem irrelevant or unnecessary. In reality, however, pediatric dentistry is a field that guarantees children healthy and aesthetic teeth during childhood, adolescence, and adulthood.

Pediatric dentistry is very important not only from the point of view of performing procedures such as milk tooth treatment, but also from the point of view of checking the overall health of the child’s mouth and teeth, and even getting the child used to proper dental care. In addition, the costs of treating children, such as the cost of treating baby teeth, are significantly lower than the costs of treatment that a child will face as an adult, which is why it is very important to attach importance to the treatment and dental check-ups of children from a financial point of view.
Who is covered by pediatric dentistry?

As the name suggests, pediatric dentistry deals with the treatment of children. However, since tooth development in children usually ends at the age of 12-13, this department mainly treats children under the age of 12. The age groups covered by the pediatric dentistry department and the general oral and dental health of these age groups can be described in a few points.
Baby teeth period (0-6 years)

In the pediatric dentistry department, the most frequently treated patients are children aged 0 to 6. The period from 0 to 6 years is when children’s baby teeth grow in and permanent teeth are already present in the jaw. Between the ages of 0 and 6, crooked teeth, tooth decay, and hypersensitivity are very common in children. In particular, infants aged 4–7 months who are teething, still breastfeeding, and have already started eating complementary foods can be observed to have many different conditions covered by pediatric dentistry. Although it may sound interesting, even young children around the age of 2 can benefit from various methods of infant dental treatment at healthcare facilities such as Dentaliva, which is one of the options for pediatric dentistry clinics in Istanbul, in order to protect the health of children’s teeth.
Mixed dentition period (6-12 years)

The dental health of children aged 6-12, which is one of the periods when problems are most common, also falls within the scope of pediatric dentistry. During this period, problems such as crooked teeth, decay of baby teeth, looseness, and tooth loss may occur. Permanent teeth may begin to erupt during this period, and their protection is very important and necessary so that the child does not require root canal treatment or dentures in the future.
Prevention in pediatric dentistry

There are many different preventive methods in pediatric dentistry. For example, medical materials such as space maintainers can be used to protect the area where a baby tooth has fallen out and make room for permanent teeth. Children who do not want to develop crooked teeth should especially benefit from this type of treatment. Preventive treatments in pediatric dentistry can be divided into several categories.
Fluoride treatments and fissure sealants

Fluoride treatments are particularly beneficial for children after their permanent teeth have erupted. Fluoridation strengthens the enamel of the teeth, which the child will use throughout their life. The fluoridation procedure is very minimal and involves the dentist applying a mixture of fluoride-containing medications to the tooth enamel.

Cavity treatment, as the name suggests, involves covering the cavities in teeth that are most vulnerable to decay with a filling material. Covering these areas with a filling material is particularly important for children who are not yet in the habit of brushing their teeth and do not pay attention to nutrition issues. Fluoridation and fissure sealing treatments are priced accordingly, taking into account the costs of pediatric dental services.
Regular checkups and early diagnosis

Many specialists in pediatric dentistry say that children should undergo dental check-ups even if they have no dental problems. Thanks to regular dental check-ups in children, many problems, such as tooth decay, can be diagnosed and treated early. In this way, beneficial results can be achieved in the long term.
Treatment methods in pediatric dentistry
In pediatric dentistry, as in adult dentistry, a variety of treatment methods can be used. Treatment methods in pediatric dentistry can be divided into several categories.
Special fillings and root canal treatment in children

Many people believe that fillings and root canal treatment are only used in adults. However, special fillings and root canal treatment can also be used in children. Children in particular, in whom it is desirable to avoid dental disease in the future and achieve favorable results through early diagnosis, should be treated with methods such as special fillings for children.
Tooth extractions and orthodontic appliances

Tooth extraction and orthodontic appliances are very often used in pediatric dentistry. In particular, children whose baby teeth do not fall out on their own, are prone to tooth decay, and do not have enough space for permanent teeth to erupt after they fall out, often undergo tooth extraction and orthodontic treatment.
Care after pediatric dental procedures and parents’ responsibilities

Care after pediatric dental procedures and protection of the child’s overall oral health are primarily the responsibility of the parents. If, as a parent, you want your child to adopt proper dental care habits after pediatric dental procedures, you may want to consider a few tips, which will be discussed in the following points.
Pay attention to your child’s diet

Paying attention to children’s diets, both after pediatric dental procedures and regardless of whether they have undergone any procedures, can mean taking care of their overall oral health. Children may be much more likely to consume products containing excessive amounts of sugar than adults. These types of products directly threaten the health of your child’s teeth. Therefore, you should make sure that your child eats foods that are beneficial to dental health after dental treatment and on a daily basis.
To help your child develop the habit of taking care of their teeth, use rewards rather than punishments

Many parents try to instill the habit of taking care of their teeth in their children by using a system of punishments. However, in reality, the most effective method of teaching children habits related to such behaviors is to use rewards rather than punishments. Playing games with your child related to brushing their teeth or preparing an interesting chart reflecting routine oral hygiene activities can make dental care a habit for your child.
How much does dental treatment for children cost?

The prices of pediatric dental treatment, or more specifically, the prices of a pediatric dentist, vary depending on the situation. The costs of many different procedures, from milk tooth treatment to orthodontic treatment, can vary significantly. Pediatric dentistry fees vary depending on the child’s dental health problems. The prices of pediatric dental treatment are determined based on the child’s dental health problems, so the treatment method that the pediatric dentist deems appropriate for the child has a very large impact on the price.

Although costs such as the cost of treating baby teeth may seem unnecessary and expensive at first, considering that the child may incur much higher costs related to dental problems in the future, it is important to cover these costs. Among the options for pediatric dentistry clinics in Istanbul are clinics such as Dentaliva, where you can take advantage of affordable pediatric dentistry prices under the supervision of a professional pediatric dentist. Therefore, if you are concerned about the prices of pediatric dentistry treatments, you should make the right choice from among the pediatric dentistry clinic options in Istanbul and plan your treatment at an affordable price with a pediatric dentistry specialist.
Frequently Asked Questions
What does pediatric dentistry deal with?

Pediatric dentistry is a field that deals with the overall oral and dental health of children. In this regard, pediatric dentistry deals with many health problems, from gum disease to tooth decay. A pediatric dentist not only treats children’s teeth but also performs routine checkups. Each of these procedures helps children throughout childhood, adolescence, and adulthood to have an aesthetic appearance and healthy teeth. Therefore, children should be taken for regular dental check-ups.
Are pediatric dental procedures painful?

Most pediatric dental procedures are not painful. In particular, procedures such as filling cavities do not cause any pain in children. However, procedures such as root canal treatment in children may cause minimal pain. In such situations, local anesthesia appropriate for the child’s age and general health can be used in pediatric dentistry. Thanks to local anesthesia methods, the child can be treated without pain.
How to overcome children's fear of the dentist?

Children’s fear of the dentist can vary depending on the reasons why the child is afraid of dentists and dental treatment. Unfortunately, some children may become afraid of dentists and dental procedures due to the inappropriate behavior and attitude of an unprofessional pediatric dentist. In such situations, it may be necessary to seek the help of a pediatrician and have the child treated at a medical facility such as Dentaliva, which employs pediatric dentists who use the right approach.
How to get children into the habit of brushing their teeth?

Teaching children to brush their teeth is not as difficult as it seems. However, delays by parents in teaching children to brush their teeth or the use of inappropriate methods can make it difficult for children to acquire this habit. Children’s teeth should be brushed from the age of 2 at the latest. At first, you should help your child brush their teeth and use their ability to imitate by showing them your own toothbrushing habits. This will help your child develop the habit of brushing their teeth in the healthiest way possible.
Are baby teeth unimportant?

One of the most common misconceptions about children’s dental health is that baby teeth are unimportant. Contrary to popular belief, baby teeth are not unimportant, and many pediatric dentistry specialists use various methods to protect baby teeth and help them stay healthy for as long as they remain in the mouth. Damage to baby teeth can lead to chewing problems in young children and even speech problems.
How is a dental examination of children performed?

Dental examinations of children are performed in different ways, depending on the situation. Pediatric dentistry specialists also undergo pedagogical training to be able to provide health services. Pedagogical training helps them gain knowledge on many topics, such as the behavioral development of children. Therefore, pediatric dentistry specialists approach children not only from a medical point of view, but also from a behavioral one, adopting the right attitudes. During a pediatric dental examination, depending on the situation, appropriate behaviors are used so that the child is not afraid of dentists and dental treatment. In addition, depending on the situation, the examination may be supplemented with procedures such as taking an X-ray of the teeth.

blocks.text: Oral, Dental and Maxillofacial Surgery

Oral and dental health is very important both in itself and for overall good health. One of the key departments dealing with many issues related to oral and dental health is the oral and maxillofacial surgery department. In the oral and dental surgery department, which is a specialized field of dentistry, individuals are diagnosed and treated using oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery instruments, effective surgical methods, and detailed analyses.

It is possible to apply to private or state-run healthcare institutions such as clinicals for oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery. To understand what oral and maxillofacial surgery entails, it is necessary to know what conditions are treated in this department and what treatment methods are used. With this information, you can benefit from effective treatments by choosing reliable and comprehensive healthcare providers such as Dentaliva, which is among the oral and maxillofacial surgery clinics.
What Does Oral, Dental, and Maxillofacial Surgery Treat?

Oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery treats many different health problems. As the name suggests, the oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery department deals with health problems that occur in tissues such as teeth or jaw tissue and require surgical intervention. Unlike fields such as jaw surgery endodontics or classical dentistry, it is a department that treats much more complex cases with effective interventions. People referred to as oral, dental, and jaw surgery doctors are also dentists. However, these individuals complete a 5-year education in dentistry and then undergo an additional 4-year specialty training in oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery. Upon successfully passing the DUS (Specialty Exam for Dentists) as a result of this training, they become oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery specialists and provide services in this field in addition to dentistry.
Diseases Treated by Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

Contrary to popular belief, oral and maxillofacial surgery is a field that deals with many health problems, not just one or a few. Some of the health problems frequently addressed in the field of oral and maxillofacial surgery can be explained in a few points.

Although many people are unaware of it, impacted teeth are actually a very important problem. If a tooth remains impacted, meaning that despite the presence of the tooth root and the need for it to erupt, it cannot erupt, this situation negatively affects other surrounding teeth and even tissues such as the jaw joint and soft tissue. While impacted teeth in children can be resolved by methods such as extracting baby teeth to make room for the existing tooth, in adults, it must be resolved with medical materials such as oral and maxillofacial surgery instruments and effective surgical interventions. In particular, impacted wisdom teeth are a very common condition and an important problem that must be addressed by an oral and maxillofacial surgeon.

Cysts may form in the jaw region, both in bone tissue and in other tissues that can be referred to as soft tissue. Some cysts are congenital, while others may develop later in life. It is particularly important and necessary to remove solid and malignant cysts using jaw surgery methods in order to preserve the jaw structure and keep the general health condition under control.

Jaw joint disorders, medically known as TMD disorders, are health problems that are usually congenital. However, in some cases, factors such as facial paralysis or traumatic accidents can also cause temporomandibular joint disorders to occur later in life. Temporomandibular joint disorders can lead to many different problems, ranging from restricted mouth movement to clicking sounds from the joint, headaches, and jaw locking. For this reason, temporomandibular joint disorders must be treated in the field of oral and maxillofacial surgery, which addresses this health problem.
The Importance of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

Oral and maxillofacial surgery is very important for many different reasons. It is not possible to treat all kinds of problems related to oral and dental health with limited methods such as classic dental treatments. At this point, jaw surgery methods come into play, making it possible to treat very important health problems such as impacted teeth or jaw joint disorders in an ideal, personalized, and correct manner. For all these reasons, it is important not to overlook the importance of the oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery department, just like other health departments and dental specialties.
Does Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Apply Braces?

Oral and maxillofacial surgery does not apply braces. Applying braces, i.e., wire treatment performed to align teeth correctly, is generally a treatment handled in the field of orthodontics. However, in rare cases, oral and maxillofacial surgeons and orthodontists may consult and jointly decide on braces treatment. Individuals who need braces treatment due to problems requiring surgical intervention in the jaw should first consult the oral and maxillofacial surgery department.
The Importance of Choosing the Right Healthcare Facility for Oral, Dental, and Maxillofacial Surgery Treatment

In order to receive appropriate, reliable, and correct treatment in oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery, you need to make the right choice of clinic for maxillofacial surgery. When trying to make an appointment for oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery, you may come across many different healthcare facility options. Unfortunately, some of these institutions are not officially recognized as healthcare institutions, meaning they have not obtained the necessary permits from the Ministry of Health and do not meet the required standards. You should avoid such institutions and choose reliable and satisfactory service providers such as Dentaliva for your oral and maxillofacial surgery appointment. By booking an appointment directly with Dentaliva for oral and maxillofacial surgery, you can benefit from comprehensive and professional healthcare services without wasting time.
The Most Common Treatments in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

Multiple treatments are performed in the field of oral and maxillofacial surgery. The most common treatment methods in the field of oral and maxillofacial surgery can be categorized under several headings.
Impacted Tooth Treatment

Impacted tooth treatment is usually performed on adults as a result of impacted wisdom teeth, but it can also be performed in other situations, albeit rarely. In impacted tooth treatment, imaging techniques such as panoramic X-rays are first used to obtain information about the position of the tooth or teeth in question. Based on this information, a detailed plan is made, and the surgical intervention phase begins. During the surgical intervention phase, local anesthesia is usually used to prevent the patient from feeling pain. After local anesthesia is administered, an incision is made, and the impacted tooth is removed in pieces or whole, depending on the situation. Special materials known as oral and maxillofacial surgery instruments are used in impacted tooth treatment, allowing treatment to be performed without damaging other surrounding tissues and teeth.
Implant Treatments

Another type of treatment frequently performed in the oral and maxillofacial surgery department is implant treatment. Especially in comprehensive implant treatments, jaw surgery expertise is required because delicate surgical intervention is necessary. In implant treatment, artificial tooth roots are placed in the gum tissue and jawbone, permanently, safely, and comfortably solving individuals’ toothlessness problems.
Treatment of Cysts in the Mouth and Jaw Areas

Another treatment frequently performed in the oral and maxillofacial surgery department is the treatment of cysts in the mouth and jaw area. In particular, a maxillofacial surgeon and their expertise are needed to remove malignant cysts and, in this context, to perform biopsies on benign cysts to determine whether they are benign or malignant. Cysts in the mouth and jaw areas can be treated correctly with operations performed by maxillofacial surgeons.
Treatment of Jaw Injuries

Jaw injuries can also be treated in the field of oral and maxillofacial surgery. Especially in cases of trauma involving a hard blow to the mouth and jaw area, it is necessary to consult the oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery department. In cases such as a broken jawbone or various types of damage to the joints, treatment is performed through closed or open surgery.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I make an appointment for oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgery?

Oral and maxillofacial surgery appointments can be made in different ways. At Dentaliva, we care about the satisfaction and overall health of our patients, so we respond as quickly as possible to patients who request an oral and maxillofacial surgery appointment.
Does oral and maxillofacial surgery perform jaw surgery?

Oral and maxillofacial surgery performs jaw surgery. When jaw surgery is mentioned, the first type of operation that comes to mind is complex operations performed to treat jawbone fractures. In addition to these surgeries, the oral and maxillofacial surgery department also performs operations to remove impacted teeth or dental implant treatments. For all these reasons, if you have a problem with your jaw and it is determined that you need jaw surgery, you should consult an oral and maxillofacial surgeon to receive appropriate treatment for your problem.
How can the difference between oral and maxillofacial surgery and dentistry be explained?

When explaining the difference between oral and maxillofacial surgery and dentistry, it is important to first understand that these two fields are not independent of each other. Individuals who are oral and maxillofacial surgeons are also dentists. However, not every dentist is an oral and maxillofacial surgeon. While only 5 years of dental education is sufficient for dentistry, oral and maxillofacial surgery requires 4 years of additional training in oral and maxillofacial surgery on top of the 5 years of dental education. Therefore, oral and maxillofacial surgery is a more comprehensive field that also covers complex operations such as jaw surgery.
Can you make an appointment directly for oral and maxillofacial surgery?

It is possible to make an appointment directly for oral and maxillofacial surgery. However, in state hospitals, you may have to wait a while to get an appointment for departments such as oral and maxillofacial surgery.
