## What is the Difference Between Aesthetic Filling and Composite Filling?

The difference between aesthetic filling and composite filling is that these two medical terms are related but have different meanings. Composite filling is actually the name of a filling material, while aesthetic filling, as the name suggests, is the use of composite filling material for aesthetic purposes. In addition, because composite filling material is frequently used in cosmetic filling applications, these two medical terms have come to be used together. Cosmetic composite filling, or in other words, bonding, is, as the name suggests, the use of composite material as a filling for cosmetic purposes.
## Advantages of Cosmetic Composite Filling

Getting aesthetic composite fillings offers many advantages. From the cost of aesthetic composite fillings being calculated at very reasonable prices to the quick solution they provide, many different features make aesthetic composite fillings an advantageous procedure. Especially if composite fillings are carefully applied by a specialist dentist, they can offer many different advantages to the individual. The advantages of the bonding procedure can be explained under several headings.
### A Fast, Economical, and Tooth-Preserving Solution (H3)

One of the most important advantages of getting aesthetic composite fillings is that this procedure offers a fast, economical, and tooth-preserving solution. When compared to many other types of fillings, the cost of aesthetic fillings is quite reasonable. In addition, the fact that composite fillings are completed in a single session and in a short time by a specialist dentist, offering a solution that preserves tooth structure, is advantageous in terms of time, overall dental health, and aesthetic appearance.
### Solving Many Dental Problems and Appearance Issues (H3)

Another major advantage of aesthetic composite fillings is that they can solve many dental problems and appearance issues at the same time. The fact that aesthetic composite fillings are customizable, meaning they can be shaped according to the patient’s wishes and needs, allows them to offer solutions tailored to individuals. For example, aesthetic composite fillings can provide solutions to problems such as discoloration and small teeth.
## Things to Consider Before and After Aesthetic Composite Fillings

There are many things to consider before and after aesthetic composite fillings. It is necessary to be careful about many different issues, from choosing a clinic to what needs to be done during the early care period. Things to consider before and after aesthetic composite fillings can be explained in more detail under several headings.
### Choosing a Clinic Before Aesthetic Composite Fillings

The most important thing to consider before aesthetic composite fillings is choosing the right clinic. Although aesthetic composite fillings may seem like a purely aesthetic and superficial procedure, they are actually a significant medical intervention. Therefore, you need to choose the right clinic before getting aesthetic composite fillings. If you agree with composite filling specialist doctors for bonding, you can manage the process in the most beneficial way.

In addition to all this, the choice of clinic is also an important factor in terms of bonding filling prices. While some clinics offer services at very high bonding filling prices, some clinics offer services at affordable aesthetic composite filling fees. If the bonding procedure is to be performed in Istanbul, you should choose healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which are among the Istanbul bonding procedure clinic options and offer services at affordable bonding filling prices. Otherwise, as a result of choosing the wrong clinic, you may end up receiving services at very high bonding filling prices due to some incorrect and unnecessary procedures performed by the clinic to increase the aesthetic filling cost.
### What to Do to Extend the Life of Your Filling

To extend the life of any filling, including aesthetic composite fillings, it is necessary to pay attention to general oral health and to know that dental hygiene is not only achieved with materials such as toothbrushes and toothpaste, but also with dental floss, mouthwash, and dental procedures. In addition, during the early healing period and perhaps throughout the entire process of using the filling, as recommended by your doctor, you should avoid chewing very hard foods with the filled tooth. Otherwise, you may have to pay for the cosmetic filling cost and have to seek services from bonding clinics in Istanbul again due to permanent damage to the filling.
## Frequently Asked Questions
### How much does cosmetic composite filling cost?

The price of aesthetic composite fillings, or in other words, bonding prices, can vary depending on multiple factors. The main factors considered when calculating bonding filling prices are the experience of the dentist performing the procedure, the facilities of the selected healthcare institution, and the individual’s requests and needs. In addition to all this, the cost of aesthetic fillings can also affect bonding prices because the prices of FDA-approved filling brands can also vary. For all these reasons, you should contact a healthcare facility directly to get clear information about the cost of aesthetic composite fillings.
### How long do cosmetic composite fillings last?

The lifespan of cosmetic composite fillings depends on many different factors, ranging from how the filling is applied to the patient’s oral hygiene habits, the quality of the composite filling material, and the capabilities of the healthcare facility where the procedure is performed. Under the right conditions and when performed using FDA-approved filling brands, aesthetic composite fillings generally last between 3 and 9 years. Factors such as the patient undergoing regular dental check-ups and not using the tooth with the filling excessively can extend this period slightly.
### Can I smoke after getting an aesthetic composite filling?

Smoking after aesthetic composite fillings is quite dangerous. Many dentists recommend not smoking for at least a few hours or, if possible, a few days after aesthetic composite fillings because smoking can compromise the filling application and your overall oral health in various ways. Smoking delays the hardening of the filling, prolongs the healing process due to reduced blood circulation, and may cause staining on the filling. For all these reasons, try not to smoke for the recommended period after cosmetic composite filling.
### Is sensitivity after aesthetic composite filling normal, and how does it go away?

Sensitivity after aesthetic composite filling is considered normal. Although many people think that aesthetic filling is a superficial procedure, important procedures such as intervention on the tooth enamel can also be performed in this application. Minimal damage to the tooth enamel can occur during procedures such as grinding and roughening the tooth, so minimal sensitivity may be experienced after the bonding procedure. There is no need to do anything to relieve this sensitivity because it will go away on its own within a short period of time.

A cracked or broken tooth is one of the most common dental problems that can cause bigger problems. Due to the potential of broken and cracked teeth, they need to be examined and treated as soon as possible. When a tooth is broken, a person feels no pain or very little pain because tooth enamel has no nerves or blood vessels. The fact that a broken tooth does not cause pain does not mean that it does not need treatment. Because the biggest purpose of applying broken tooth treatment in the first stage is to prevent bigger problems in the future.
If a broken or cracked tooth is not treated early on, some discomforts that will be experienced are as follows:
Sensitivity to hot or cold
Discomfort in the palate, lips and mouth,

Teeth can break for different reasons. Before applying the appropriate dental practice among dental treatments, it is important to determine how the tooth broke. Because the most appropriate treatment type is preferred depending on the way the tooth broke.
A crack in a tooth can sometimes cause the tooth to split in two. This is usually experienced in cases of cracked teeth from the tooth surface to the gum line.
In another case, a vertical crack forms on the tooth surface up to the gum line.
Some tooth cracks start below the gum line and progress upwards.
There may be many small and thin cracks in the tooth enamel. The fact that they do not cause any discomfort in the mouth does not mean that the tooth will not weaken.
Why Do Teeth Break?

There are many different reasons why teeth can break. Moreover, there are different situations that increase the risk of tooth breakage. The most common reason for tooth breakage is exposure to impact. Biting a very hard object, having an accident or falling, doing hard sports without protecting the mouth area are all impacts that teeth can be exposed to. In addition to these, grinding your teeth while sleeping is another reason that most often leads to tooth breakage.

Other factors that increase the risk of tooth fractures include tooth decay, weakened tooth enamel, large and wide fillings, constant consumption of highly acidic foods and drinks, excessive sugar production and age-related erosion of tooth enamel, eating disorders, and excessive alcohol consumption.
Broken Tooth Treatment Ways
Broken or cracked teeth are treated individually. In other words, it is definitely not right to apply the same treatment to every patient.

If you have a broken tooth, it is essential to see a dentist without wasting time to protect your teeth and oral health. However, it is also possible to take various precautions before being examined. You should apply a cold compress to prevent possible swelling, rinse your mouth with salt water and clean your teeth, and use nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs to reduce pain and prevent swelling. Later, during the dentist’s examination, various treatment methods can be decided according to the condition of the broken or cracked tooth.
Commonly preferred treatment methods for broken teeth are as follows:

Porcelain Lamina: Porcelain Laminate: Porcelain laminate treatment, which is among the most popular aesthetic dentistry applications within the scope of smile aesthetics, is one of the most effective treatment methods for the front broken or cracked teeth. Leaf porcelains restore the natural appearance of broken and cracked teeth.
Bonding: This method is to add special composite materials to the teeth. It is another preferred method in broken tooth treatments. The dentist decides whether the procedure will be applied or not.
Filling: One of the most reliable and common treatment methods for treating broken teeth is filling. It is a treatment method that involves filling the cracks in a small part of the teeth.
Root Canal Treatment: Teeth that are broken, especially due to decay, are prone to infection. In this case, root canal treatment can protect the natural tooth and prevent infection.

Implant: In some cases, the condition of the broken tooth can be so bad that it cannot be treated with different techniques and treatments. If the crack or fracture in the tooth is damaged down to the gum, the tooth is extracted. In other words, the tooth is lost. The best treatment method to replace the lost tooth to provide both natural tooth function and an aesthetic smile is a dental implant.
Negativities Caused by Broken Teeth

There are many negative situations caused by broken or cracked teeth. These negativities may vary depending on the location of the broken tooth and the size of the fracture. For example, if one of the front teeth is broken, aesthetic appearance may be the biggest problem. However, if the cracked tooth is one of the back teeth, you are more likely to have chewing problems.

Another negative situation caused by broken or cracked teeth is pain. A broken tooth can cause pain immediately after breaking or after a long period of time. The biggest reason for the pain of broken teeth may be the displacement of the tooth root or enamel.

Broken teeth are no longer as strong as healthy teeth because some of their parts are missing. Cracks, especially those that extend to the tooth enamel, are the biggest reason for tooth decay over time.

blocks.text: In the field of orthodontics, many different treatment methods are used to help individuals overcome what is commonly referred to as crooked teeth. Invisalign, a method that comes to mind when talking about wireless orthodontics and is also known as invisible braces, is a treatment that offers many advantages. Invisalign is a method used for teeth straightening and is performed using transparent aligners. Contrary to popular belief, it is not necessary to resort only to methods such as braces to correct the alignment of teeth, i.e., to have aesthetically aligned teeth.

Invisalign clinics in Istanbul are a type of clinic found in large numbers in cities. These types of clinics are usually healthcare institutions that offer dental treatments, primarily orthodontic treatments. Reliable healthcare institutions, such as Dentaliva, which is among the Invisalign clinic Istanbul options, offer comprehensive treatments with expert Invisalign dentists. To gain comprehensive information about Invisalign treatment, it is also necessary to learn about detailed topics such as the factors that determine clear brace costs and who is eligible for clear aligner treatment. If you would like to benefit from aligner treatment in Istanbul, you can contact us to make an Invisalign treatment appointment.
Who is Invisalign Treatment Suitable For?

Invisalign treatment is suitable for many different individuals. Invisalign, or in other words, clear aligner treatment, is considered suitable for many different patient profiles because it can offer solutions to many different problems. The patient profiles that can benefit from Invisalign treatment can be summarized under a few headings.
Individuals with Mild to Moderate Dental Malocclusion

Invisalign doctors, who are orthodontic specialists, recommend methods such as clear aligner treatment instead of complicated methods such as braces, especially for individuals with mild to moderate dental malocclusion. The main reason for this is that situations such as slightly misaligned teeth or slight gaps between teeth do not actually require difficult treatment methods such as braces. In addition, Invisalign prices are much higher than methods such as braces, so clear aligner treatment can also provide patients with financial advantages.
Adult and Young Patients with Aesthetic Concerns

Some individuals have aesthetic concerns about various issues. Many different situations, ranging from individuals being bothered by even small gaps between their teeth to avoiding situations that cause major changes in appearance, such as braces treatment, cause young adult patients in particular to turn to Invisalign treatment. In addition, for individuals who have undergone orthodontic treatment during childhood and adolescence but have not achieved a complete solution or who are faced with appearance problems such as diastema again, Invisalign treatment can offer solutions in adulthood that are almost painless and do not spoil the appearance.
Those Looking for Invisible Orthodontic Treatment

Clear aligner treatment is preferred not only because its cost is lower than many other methods but also because it is invisible. Many people complain that traditional orthodontic treatments are very visible from the outside and significantly alter the overall appearance of the mouth. For these individuals, Invisalign clear aligner treatment can provide effective solutions with the invisible orthodontic treatment they desire. For all these reasons, Invisalign is also used for individuals seeking invisible orthodontic treatment.
How is Invisalign Treatment Performed?

Many people think that Invisalign treatment consists of getting and using standard clear aligners. However, this is not actually the case. An Invisalign clinic in Istanbul, as well as in any other region, offers personalized solutions. In Invisalign treatment, many factors, from the measurements of the clear aligners to be used to how long the aligners will be worn, depend on the individual’s wishes and needs. For this reason, Invisalign treatment is carried out in several steps. The steps of Invisalign treatment can be explained under several headings.
Consultation, 3D Imaging, and Digital Treatment Planning

The first step in Invisalign treatment is a consultation between the patient and the dentist. During this consultation, the specialist Invisalign dentist obtains information on many important topics, from the patient’s medical history to why they want to benefit from Invisalign treatment. The dentist’s knowledge of these important topics, reinforced by information obtained through 3D imaging methods, helps them plan the treatment. Depending on the situation, digital smile design applications may be used as part of digital treatment planning to simulate the final result of the treatment and present it to the patient.
Production and Use of Clear Aligners

Another crucial step in Invisalign treatment is, of course, the production of clear aligners. Since clear aligners are the main material of Invisalign treatment, this material must be produced with great care, under the right laboratory conditions, and customized for each individual. This is one of the most important factors determining the cost of clear aligner treatment. Clear aligners are designed to fit perfectly on the individual’s teeth and correct the alignment of the teeth. Clear aligners are generally worn continuously, except when eating, drinking, and cleaning teeth. However, in some cases, it may be sufficient to wear clear aligners only at night while sleeping.
Treatment Checkups and Aligner Replacement

Although many people view Invisalign treatment as superficial, insignificant, and based solely on the random use of aligners, this is not actually the case. Invisalign treatment is actually a very important medical treatment and may even be essential in some cases. Regular check-ups are required as part of Invisalign treatment. During these check-ups, aligners may be changed depending on the alignment of the teeth. Changing aligners ensures that teeth are aligned correctly in the shortest time and in the healthiest way possible.
Advantages of Invisalign Treatment

Invisalign treatment offers advantages in many different ways. Especially when classic orthodontic treatments are considered, the advantages of Invisalign treatment become apparent. It offers advantages in many different aspects, from Invisalign prices to its comfortable structure. The advantages of Invisalign treatment can be summarized under several headings.
Nearly Invisible and Comfortable Design

Invisalign treatment is nearly invisible because it is performed with clear aligners. This is why many people know Invisalign treatment as wireless orthodontic treatment. The fact that Invisalign treatment is performed with clear aligners, making it invisible, provides significant comfort and advantages, especially from an aesthetic perspective. There is no need for individuals to worry that their oral appearance will change and look bad aesthetically with Invisalign treatment.
Ease of Eating and Brushing Teeth

One of the main reasons why a specialist Invisalign dentist strongly recommends Invisalign treatment is that it offers advantages in terms of ease during activities such as eating and brushing teeth. With methods such as wire treatments used for teeth straightening, activities such as eating and brushing teeth can become more difficult due to factors such as the discomfort of the wire. However, with Invisalign treatment, the clear aligners can be removed during such activities. This means that there is no extra difficulty during activities such as eating and brushing teeth.
Short Treatment Time and Predictable Results

Among the greatest advantages offered by Invisalign treatment are its short treatment time and predictable results. While many treatment methods involve long waiting times and unpredictable results, this is not the case with Invisalign treatment. Especially when Invisalign treatment is performed with digital smile design, the results can be simulated and shown to the patient. Achieving the simulated results in a short time is quite advantageous in terms of comfort and time savings. The short duration of Invisalign treatment also offers advantages in terms of reducing the cost of clear aligner treatment.
Offering Financial Advantages with Low Invisalign Prices

Transparent braces fees or the cost of traditional braces, when considering the prices of orthodontic treatments, show how affordable Invisalign prices are. Treatments performed at healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, which is among the Invisalign clinic Istanbul options, by expert Invisalign dentists can also offer financial advantages. When looking at the cost of clear aligner treatment, it can be seen that clear aligner fees are much lower than traditional braces fees. Therefore, instead of paying clear aligner fees with the help of specialist Invisalign dentists, it may be a much smarter and financially advantageous choice to take advantage of affordable Invisalign clear aligner prices.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much do Invisalign treatments cost?

Invisalign clear aligner prices are determined based on multiple factors. Therefore, it would not be accurate to provide specific information about Invisalign prices. When calculating the cost of clear aligner treatment, many different factors are taken into account, such as the quality of the clear aligners selected, the duration of treatment, and the dentist’s experience. Therefore, if you want to obtain clear and relevant pricing information about Invisalign treatment costs, you can request information by contacting healthcare institutions specializing in Invisalign treatment, such as Dentaliva.
How long do Invisalign clear aligners need to be worn?

One of the most frequently asked questions regarding Invisalign treatment is how long these clear aligners need to be worn. Contrary to popular belief, there is no clear or even average timeframe for how long Invisalign clear aligners need to be worn. Invisalign treatment is personalized, and individuals’ needs may vary. Individuals with moderate alignment problems can achieve a solution with months of Invisalign treatment, while individuals with more severe alignment problems may take over a year to achieve results.
Will teeth become misaligned again after Invisalign treatment?

Whether teeth become misaligned again after Invisalign treatment may vary depending on the situation. Although many treatment methods, such as clear aligners or traditional braces, are effective for teeth straightening, in some cases, teeth may shift again. Individuals with general oral and jaw structure problems, in particular, may experience recurrence. Therefore, you should seek help from specialist Invisalign dentists to maximize both the duration and effectiveness of the treatment.
Is Invisalign treatment painful?

Contrary to popular belief, Invisalign treatment is not very painful. While orthodontic treatments such as traditional braces cause a lot of pain due to intense pressure and intervention, Invisalign clear aligner treatment does not cause intense pain. However, in very rare cases, some individuals may experience minimal pain and discomfort during the initial period of using clear aligners due to the pressure exerted on the teeth and the unfamiliar sensation. This pain and discomfort can be controlled even with mild pain relievers.

However, gaps between teeth are medically known as diastema, which can cause various problems. Diastema can be congenital in some cases and acquired in others. However, in general, diastema is a problem that occurs congenitally in individuals and progresses further due to factors such as pressure from other teeth. Although the gaps between teeth in question usually occur in the two front teeth, they can rarely be seen in other teeth as well. The treatment known as diastema closure is performed using tooth filling methods.

When diastema aesthetic filling materials are used, functional problems, dental health issues, and aesthetic problems are eliminated. However, for diastema treatment to be performed effectively and safely, you need to choose a reliable and professional healthcare facility. For example, reliable healthcare facilities such as Dentaliva, which is among the diastema closure Istanbul clinic options, perform procedures using highly effective and reliable methods for diastema treatment. In this way, diastema aesthetic dentist interventions can offer advantages in many different ways. To learn more about the diastema problem, it is necessary to be knowledgeable about many different and important topics, from the reasons for its occurrence to the ways it can be treated.
What Causes Diastema?
There are multiple conditions that cause diastema, or in other words, gaps between teeth. The conditions that cause diastema can be explained in detail in a few points.

Contrary to popular belief, gum disease can damage not only the gums but also the teeth themselves. In particular, health problems known as gum inflammation and gum recession can negatively affect the alignment of the teeth or, in other words, their position. This situation can also cause the individual to face a problem of gaps between teeth that has developed later on. For all these reasons, it is necessary to protect yourself from problems such as diastema, even indirectly, without ignoring health problems such as gum disease.

Although it may sound interesting, genetic factors can cause gaps between teeth. In individuals whose jawbone size is genetically much larger than their teeth size, gaps between teeth may occur due to disproportion. This is why diastema is commonly seen in individuals with a wide lower face line. Diastema caused by genetic factors can be treated by an aesthetic dentist or an oral, dental, and maxillofacial surgeon.
Improper Dental Aesthetic Procedures

Improper performance of any medical procedure, including dental aesthetic procedures, can lead to various problems, including the formation of gaps between teeth. Expert dental aesthetic procedures that are not performed professionally and under the right conditions can lead to extreme gaps between teeth. For example, it can occur due to dental veneers applied by someone who is not a diastema cosmetic dentist, i.e., someone who is not specialized in dental aesthetic procedures or who is not actually a dentist, because procedures such as excessive grinding of teeth in such delicate applications can cause permanent gaps between teeth.
Should Diastema Always Be Treated?

When it comes to diastema treatment, many people question whether diastema is a problem that always needs to be treated. Diastema may not appear to be a problem at first glance, and some people may think that gaps between teeth, especially in the front teeth, do not cause any aesthetic or functional problems. However, this is not always the case. Diastema is considered a problem that requires treatment in many cases. There are several important reasons for this. To understand why diastema treatment may be necessary, it is important to know the problems that diastema can cause.
Aesthetic and Functional Problems Caused by Tooth Gaps
Deterioration of Aesthetic Appearance

If diastema, or gaps between teeth, is very minimal, it does not cause a bad appearance and may even give the individual a characteristic look according to some aesthetic perceptions. However, if the problem of gaps between teeth is very advanced, meaning the gaps between the teeth are very large, this can cause a deterioration in the overall aesthetic appearance. Especially when extremely large gaps between teeth are involved, this situation can become very uncomfortable because it deprives the individual of a healthy tooth and smile appearance and may necessitate treatments such as diastema aesthetic filling.
Deterioration of Dental Health

Although it may sound surprising, the gap between teeth problem can even lead to the deterioration of dental health. This is why many diastema cosmetic dentists consider diastema treatment important and necessary. When the gaps between teeth are very wide, it becomes much easier for food to accumulate in these gaps, leading to tartar and decay. In addition to all this, large gaps between teeth can make cleaning teeth difficult, paving the way for complicated problems such as gum disease. For all these reasons, individuals with gaps between their teeth that are wide enough to cause dental health problems may need to undergo diastema closure treatment.
Impairment of Chewing and Speaking Functions

Another situation that makes diastema closure treatment important and necessary is that gaps between teeth can impair chewing and speaking functions. Your tongue must touch your teeth for certain sounds to come out of your mouth. Gaps between teeth, especially in the front teeth, can make it difficult for individuals to produce certain sounds and indirectly impair their speech function. In addition, gaps in the back teeth can impair chewing function and necessitate diastema treatment.
Is Professional Dental Aesthetics Diastema Treatment Very Expensive?

Many people think that professional dental aesthetics diastema treatment is extremely expensive. However, contrary to popular belief, professional dental aesthetics diastema treatment is not very expensive. Especially among the diastema closure Istanbul clinic options, a diastema closure Istanbul clinic that has adopted an affordable service policy, such as Dentaliva, provides services at an affordable diastema closure fee. In order to provide services at an affordable diastema closure fee, some methods that reduce the price of dental gap treatment can be used.

If diastema closure is performed quickly by an aesthetic dentist, if methods such as affordable filling applications that will reduce the diastema closure fee are used, and if the specialist dental aesthetics diastema treatment uses other ways to reduce the price, you can receive services at a very affordable diastema closure fee.
What is Diastema Closure and How is it Done?

Different methods can be used for diastema closure, i.e., closing the gaps between teeth. First of all, you should know that a procedure such as closing separated teeth at home cannot be performed and that diastema closure treatments must be performed by a dentist who is knowledgeable and experienced in specialized dental aesthetics applications. The methods that can be used for diastema closure can be discussed under several headings.
Closing the Gap Between Teeth with Bonding (Composite Filling)

The most commonly used method for diastema treatment is closure with composite filling. Composite filling is a very suitable material for diastema closure because it allows the space between the teeth to be filled in a way that provides a natural appearance without excessive or any abrasion of the tooth within the scope of diastema aesthetic filling treatment. In addition, bonding, i.e., composite filling, is also a positive factor in terms of the cost of diastema closure because it is cheaper than materials such as porcelain laminates and makes more affordable treatment possible.
Aesthetic and Permanent Results with Porcelain Veneers (Porcelain Laminates)

Porcelain veneers can be used both as a diastema aesthetic filling treatment and to change the overall appearance of the teeth. Porcelain laminate, also known as leaf porcelain, can close tooth gaps with a very thin coating, giving the tooth a white and aesthetic appearance. Porcelain laminate can increase the cost of closing gaps between teeth, but since it can be used almost indefinitely with proper care, it may be the ideal coating material for some individuals.
Comprehensive Solution with Orthodontic Treatment (Braces and Clear Aligners)

Orthodontic treatments can also be an effective solution for diastema problems. Especially when it comes to gaps between teeth that are congenital and very wide, using braces or clear aligners to bring the teeth closer together can be the ideal method to get rid of gaps between teeth. In addition, orthodontic treatments can solve multiple problems by eliminating other misalignments in the teeth as well as closing the gaps between teeth.

Congenital gaps between teeth can sometimes be caused by the frenulum, which is located between the upper lip and the gum. The pressure created by this connective tissue can lead to the diastema problem. Thanks to a surgical intervention on this connective tissue, or a frenectomy operation, the condition causing the diastema is eliminated, and it becomes possible to permanently correct the diastema with minimal methods such as short-term plaque treatment.

Things to consider before and after diastema treatment may vary depending on the situation. Diastema treatment is not performed using a single standard method but rather using different methods depending on the situation. Therefore, what should or should not be done before and after diastema treatment may also vary depending on the situation. However, in general, before diastema treatment, it is necessary to go to a reliable healthcare institution such as Dentaliva instead of using common and dangerous methods such as home teeth alignment, pay attention to general oral hygiene, and follow the dentist’s recommendations. Similarly, after diastema treatment, it is necessary to act in accordance with the dentist’s recommendations.

Diastema treatment varies depending on the situation. How diastema treatment is performed must be determined by a dentist who has knowledge and experience in specialized dental aesthetics. Treatment can be performed using methods such as diastema aesthetic filling, based on the decisions made by the dentist, taking into account the patient’s needs and wishes. However, in general, diastema treatment, like other treatments, is performed in several steps.
Comprehensive Examination and Planning Before Treatment

When dealing with a problem like diastema, which can cause both aesthetic and functional issues, an examination is necessary to obtain comprehensive information about the patient’s overall oral health. Based on the information obtained from this examination and possibly imaging methods such as panoramic dental X-rays, a personalized plan is created for the patient.
Personalized, Fast, and Effective Interventions During Treatment

Diastema treatment requires another important step: fast and effective interventions based on a personalized plan. These medical interventions may include procedures such as interdental filling. To ensure these procedures are performed in the most effective and healthy way, they must be carried out at reliable and professional healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva.

Does diastema/tooth gap go away on its own?

Diastema, or tooth gap, does not go away on its own. Whether congenital or acquired, tooth gaps do not disappear without intervention. In addition, tooth gaps can often grow larger over time. Gaps caused by health problems such as gum disease can grow rapidly and become very uncomfortable if not treated properly. Therefore, instead of thinking that diastema, or tooth gaps, will go away on their own or resorting to unreliable methods such as home tooth gap closure, it is necessary to consult a dentist.
How long does diastema treatment take?

The duration of diastema treatment varies depending on the situation. The duration of diastema treatment may vary depending on the method chosen for treatment. If diastema aesthetic filling applications are used for treatment, the treatment can be completed in one or several sessions. However, if treatment methods such as braces or dental plates are used for diastema treatment, it may take months to see results from these treatments.
How much does diastema closure cost?

The cost of diastema closure, or in other words, the price of closing gapped teeth, or in other words, the fee for diastema closure, is determined by several factors. When determining diastema treatment prices, pricing is based on both the patient’s specific circumstances and the characteristics of the healthcare facility performing the treatment. Many different factors can affect the average diastema treatment price, from the location of the healthcare facility to the patient’s requests and the content of the treatment. For example, diastema treatment in Istanbul can be priced differently than in smaller cities.
When will the tooth gap close with braces?

When the tooth gap will close with braces depends on multiple factors. In this case, the most important factor affecting the duration of treatment is the size of the tooth gap. Tooth gaps that are not very large can be eliminated with braces treatment, which can be completed in a relatively short period of time, such as a few months. However, if the tooth gap is very large and, especially, if there is a tooth alignment problem accompanying the tooth gap, it may be necessary to undergo braces treatment for several years to close the tooth gap. Therefore, you should consult your dentist to get an average idea of the duration of the braces treatment you will undergo for your tooth gap.
What is the best method for diastema treatment?

It would not be correct to mention a single technique as the best method for diastema treatment. The best method for treating diastema in an individual is the method determined according to their wishes and needs. Since the goal of diastema treatments is to provide both aesthetic and functional benefits, it is necessary to choose the most suitable method for the individual, or in other words, the best method for the individual, taking into account the dentist’s recommendations, patient requests, and various factors. For individuals with minimal tooth gaps, i.e., those with very small spaces between their teeth, the problem can be solved with ideal methods such as diastema aesthetic filling, while individuals with very large tooth gaps may need to resort to braces.
Is diastema treatment very painful?

A common belief about diastema treatment is that it is very painful. However, this is not true in every case. With cosmetic fillings, which are often preferred for diastema treatment, it is almost impossible to experience pain either during or after the procedure. However, when more complex treatments such as braces or surgical methods are involved, pain may occur after diastema treatment. This pain can be controlled with painkillers.

blocks.text: Veneer applications in dentistry are methods used for many different purposes. Veneers can be used in many different situations, from correcting aesthetic appearance to solving certain problems. Contrary to popular belief, dental veneers are not all the same. Dental veneers differ from each other depending on the material used and the purpose of the application. In particular, zirconium veneers are one of the most popular dental veneer applications.

Contrary to popular belief, zirconium veneers are not only applied to front teeth. Zirconium veneers can also be applied to back teeth. However, zirconium veneer applications on front teeth are much more popular than zirconium veneer applications on back teeth. It is one of the rare dental veneer applications with obvious differences between before and after zirconium veneers and offers many advantages. However, in order to benefit from zirconium veneers, they must be applied by a specialist zirconium dentist or, more accurately, a dentist who specializes in dental veneers. For all these reasons, you should choose professional service providers such as Dentaliva, which is among the zirconium clinic Istanbul options. To gain more comprehensive information about zirconium veneers, you need to learn detailed information such as the stages of zirconium veneers, the advantages of zirconium veneers, and what to consider before and after zirconium veneers.
Differences Between Zirconium Crowns and Metal-Supported Crowns

Zirconium crowns are a type of crown that must be considered differently from metal-supported crowns in many ways. The differences between zirconium crowns and metal-supported crowns can be summarized in a few points.

Zirconium veneers are one of the rare types of veneers that are not metal-supported, so unlike metal-supported veneers, the risk of allergy is quite low. When it comes to metal-supported veneers, allergic reactions can occur, especially in individuals who are sensitive to metal. However, since zirconium veneers have no metal backing, allergic reactions and symptoms of metal sensitivity are virtually impossible. Therefore, while problems such as gum issues may occur with metal-backed veneers due to metal sensitivity, this is not the case when zirconium veneers are applied to teeth.
Providing a Natural and Aesthetic Appearance

Metal-supported dental crowns have very low light transmittance due to their metal content. In some cases, metal-supported crowns may even reflect light, resulting in an unnatural appearance. However, this is not the case with zirconium crowns. The material used in zirconium veneers provides a natural appearance and light transmission similar to natural tooth enamel, which generally helps achieve an aesthetic appearance. This is why many people prefer zirconium veneers over metal-supported veneers when considering dental veneers, due to the natural and aesthetic appearance they provide.
Possibility of Hot/Cold Sensitivity

Since dental veneers become a natural part of the tooth, how well the veneers conduct heat is a very important factor. Metal-supported dental veneers conduct heat to a high degree and can therefore cause sensitivity when consuming hot or cold food and beverages. However, this is not the case with zirconium veneers. Since zirconium is an insulating material, it does not conduct heat and cold to the natural tooth to a large extent. This means that individuals are much less likely to experience sensitivity when consuming hot and cold foods or beverages.
Who Can Benefit from Zirconium Veneers?

Zirconium veneers are suitable for many people because they are a comprehensive and safe application. However, individuals with extreme oral and dental diseases or those in sensitive periods such as pregnancy cannot benefit from zirconium veneers, as is the case with many dental treatments. In addition to all this, who specifically can benefit from zirconium veneers can be explained under a few headings.
People Who Want an Aesthetic Appearance

Zirconium veneers are a type of veneer that can appeal to many different patient profiles. However, zirconium veneers can be considered the ideal option, especially for people who want an aesthetic appearance. The main reason for this is that zirconium veneers offer a highly aesthetic, natural, and vibrant appearance due to their specific characteristics, such as their overall appearance and light transmittance.
Individuals at Risk of Allergic Reactions

Another patient profile that zirconium veneers appeal to most are individuals at risk of allergic reactions. Individuals at risk of allergic reactions should not use metal-supported dental veneers. Otherwise, there may be adverse effects, including gum disease. However, since zirconium veneers do not have metal support, they can be considered the ideal option for individuals at risk of allergic reactions.
How Are Zirconium Veneers Made?

Contrary to popular belief, zirconium veneers are not a superficial and insignificant application, but rather a delicate medical procedure. For this reason, zirconium veneers are applied with great care, going through various stages. The stages of zirconium veneers can be discussed under several headings.
Tooth Preparation and Measurement Stages

The first step in the zirconium veneer process is examining the tooth, preparing it for treatment, and taking measurements. Taking measurements is a particularly important and necessary step because incorrect measurements and improper fitting of the veneer can lead to bad breath from zirconium veneers. In such cases, the main reason for the zirconium veneer causing bad breath is the growth of bacteria due to food accumulation in the gaps between the veneer and the tooth. As part of the tooth preparation, the tooth may need to be filed down and thinned to make it suitable for veneering, depending on the situation.
Preparation and Application of the Veneer in the Laboratory Environment

After the measurement and preparation stages, the crown is prepared in a laboratory environment to suit the individual. In addition, factors such as the materials chosen by the individual, taking into account factors such as the cost of zirconium teeth, are also considered. Once the crown is ready, it is placed on the tooth with special adhesives. This ensures maximum stability and durability.
Types of Zirconium Dental Crowns

Although zirconium dental crowns are a type of dental crown, these crowns can be divided into different types. Zirconium dental crown types can be categorized into two different types: full zirconium crowns and zirconium-supported porcelain crowns.
Full Zirconium Crowns

As the name suggests, full zirconium crowns are crowns made entirely of zirconium material. Since no metal is used in full zirconium crowns, this type of crown is considered a highly reliable option. However, full zirconium crowns may offer less effective aesthetic results compared to zirconium-supported porcelain crowns.
Zirconium-Supported Porcelain Crowns

Zirconium-supported porcelain crowns are a type of crown that offers much more aesthetic results compared to full zirconium crowns. Zirconium-supported porcelain crowns combine the durability of zirconium in the base structure with the aesthetic effects of porcelain in the upper structure, yielding highly satisfactory results. However, zirconium-supported porcelain veneers can increase the total cost of zirconium aesthetic veneers because the cost of zirconium teeth using porcelain is higher than the cost of full zirconium veneers.
What are the advantages of zirconium veneers?

The main reason zirconium veneers are such a popular choice among dental veneers is that they offer advantages in many ways. It is an effective type of veneer that offers many advantages, with noticeable positive differences between before and after zirconium veneers. Natural Appearance and Light Transmittance

blocks.text: Periodontology is a dental specialty that deals with the tissues inside the mouth. The periodontology department deals specifically with the tissues that connect the teeth to the jawbone and enable the teeth to function properly. Health problems related to these tissues and periodontal care procedures, such as scaling, are performed within the scope of periodontology. Periodontology, or in other words, gum treatment clinics in Istanbul, are very numerous in cities such as Istanbul. Therefore, there are many clinics where you can be examined and treated by a specialist periodontist.
Periodontitis (advanced gum disease)

Periodontitis, advanced gum diseaseGum treatment clinics in Istanbul Healthcare facilities that prioritize patient satisfaction, such as Dentaliva, offer affordable prices for services such as gum recession treatment. Therefore, choosing healthcare facilities such as Dentaliva, which is one of the options for gum disease clinics in Istanbul, means receiving comprehensive and reliable services, as well as meeting your medical needs without financial burden, thanks to affordable prices for periodontal treatment. In addition, it is necessary to obtain detailed information on this subject in order to understand what a periodontology department is and what health problems it addresses.
What does the periodontology department focus on?

The periodontology department deals with many different problems and conditions. For example, teeth brushing techniques periodontology can be discussed in a field that specifically deals with topics such as gum health. However, in general, the health problems that the periodontology department deals with can be discussed in several points.
Gingivitis (periodontitis)

Gingivitis, known in medicine as periodontitis, is a health problem. Gingivitis is actually a health problem that can underlie many dental diseases and lead to various problems. Gingivitis is a health problem that often occurs in people who neglect periodontal care and general oral and dental hygiene. With gingivitis, the gums may bleed, redden, swell, and look completely different from healthy gums when brushing or without any external factors. Gingivitis is usually treated with gum disease treatments such as scaling and, depending on the situation, medication. Gingivitis, one of the most common gum diseases, is a health problem that should not be ignored as it threatens overall oral health.

As the name suggests, periodontitis is an advanced form of gingivitis. In the early stages of gingivitis, only the gums are affected, while in advanced gum disease, such as periodontitis, the tissues surrounding the teeth and even the jawbone are affected. Because periodontitis is an advanced health problem, certain surgical methods, also known as periodontal surgery, are used to treat it. If periodontitis is ignored and neglected, not only can a person’s oral and dental health be at risk, but so can their overall health. In addition, the development of advanced gum disease can have disastrous financial consequences, as it leads to significantly higher costs of periodontal treatment than the costs of treating gum disease associated with gingivitis.
Gingival hyperplasia (gum enlargement)

In some cases, gum growth is due to health problems related to hormonal imbalances, and in other cases, it is due to a lack of oral and dental care. As the name suggests, with gum growth, the gums may begin to cover the teeth like sagging tissue and even create a strange appearance called gum hypertrophy. Excessive gum growth is one of the serious health problems that raise concerns about gum health. However, in order to address the problem of excessive gum growth, other doctors who deal with a person’s hormonal status are also consulted at the periodontal clinic to create a personalized and appropriate treatment plan. Periodontal specialists can perform surgical procedures to treat excessive gum growth.
What are the symptoms of periodontal disease?

Periodontal diseases are health problems that are not very insidious, meaning that they manifest themselves with fairly visible symptoms. The symptoms of periodontal disease, i.e., signs that indicate that gum health is not in good condition, can be discussed in several points.
Bleeding and swelling of the gums

Bleeding and swelling of the gums are among the most obvious symptoms of periodontal disease. Bleeding gums, especially frequent bleeding or swelling, cannot be considered normal. Bleeding and swelling of the gums are a general symptom of gum disease or periodontal disease. Therefore, if your gums are bleeding and swollen, do not delay in making an appointment with a periodontist.
Loose teeth and bad breath

Another symptom of periodontal disease is loose teeth and bad breath. Especially in advanced stages of gum disease, teeth begin to loosen and a very unpleasant problem of bad breath appears, because the health of the teeth is now completely compromised. Loose teeth indicate that you should immediately see a periodontist, because if you do not seek medical help at this stage, you may lose your teeth completely.
How is periodontal treatment performed?

The method of periodontal treatment, i.e., procedures performed in the periodontology department, may vary depending on the situation. The method of periodontal treatment depends on the cost of gum treatment, the patient’s preferences and medical needs, as well as the dentist’s opinion. However, in general, periodontal treatment can be divided into several categories.
Tartar removal and root planing

Periodontal treatment most often involves tartar removal and root planing. Special devices with vibrating tips are usually used to remove tartar in periodontology. In addition to these devices, very precise medical instruments are also used for thorough cleaning. Root planing is performed with instruments called curettes. Curettes are instruments used to clean the surface of tooth roots, ensuring precise and effective results. Root planing can become particularly important and necessary, especially in the case of pocket formation.
Advanced surgical methods (flap surgery, grafts)

Another type of treatment in periodontology is surgery using advanced surgical methods. Even advanced gum disease can be treated with procedures that fall within the scope of periodontal surgery, such as flap tissue surgery and grafting procedures. However, to achieve effective results, these delicate surgeries must be performed by a specialist periodontist.
Laser periodontal treatment

Advances in periodontology have also led to the use of innovative laser-assisted treatment methods. Especially in cases of gum disease such as gingival hyperplasia, laser technology can be used to trim the gums without surgical intervention. This has a positive effect on oral health, as damaged tissue is also removed.
Antibiotic and drug-assisted treatment

Antibiotic and drug-assisted treatment is used to dry out gum inflammation from the inside and eliminate problems such as hormone-induced gum growth. In this context, a periodontist can provide individualized drug treatment in consultation with other doctors.
What determines the cost of periodontal treatment?

The cost of periodontal treatment varies depending on a number of factors. The main factors influencing the cost of gum treatment, and therefore specific fees such as the cost of gum recession treatment, are the location of the medical facility where the treatment will be performed, the methods used in the treatment, and the patient’s needs. If you want to take advantage of affordable prices for treatments such as gum recession treatment or the total cost of gum treatment, you can choose Dentaliva, which is one of the gum treatment clinics in Istanbul and offers affordable prices.
The impact of periodontal health on overall health

Periodontal health affects not only oral and dental health, but also overall health. Deterioration of periodontal health, or in other words, the onset of gum disease, can even cause blood sugar levels to deteriorate, leading to diseases such as diabetes.
The importance of periodontal health during pregnancy

Hormonal irregularities and other sensitive changes that occur during pregnancy put women at additional risk for periodontal health problems. Therefore, women should consult a specialist by making an appointment with a periodontist, even if they are only planning to become pregnant, and remain under supervision throughout their pregnancy.
Frequently Asked Questions
How to make an appointment with a periodontist?

Appointments with a periodontist can be made in various ways, depending on the situation. The method of making appointments with a periodontist varies depending on the healthcare facility you choose. The appointment process may differ between public hospitals and private healthcare facilities. If you would like to take advantage of Dentaliva’s periodontal examinations and treatments, you can make an appointment with a periodontist by contacting us via our website or WhatsApp support line.
Are periodontal treatments very painful?

It is commonly believed that periodontal treatments are very painful. However, this belief is actually misleading and, in some cases, should be considered a myth. Periodontal treatments are not always very painful. In some cases, you can undergo periodontal treatment without feeling any pain. Especially with innovative treatment methods such as laser gum cutting, which is performed under local anesthesia, you will not feel any pain during the procedure.
What happens if periodontal treatment is not performed?

The consequences of not undergoing periodontal treatment may vary depending on the extent of the treatment and the patient’s overall health. If a periodontist recommends periodontal treatment to a patient, or even considers it necessary, it is important not to waste time. Delaying and not undergoing periodontal treatment means that minor health problems such as gingivitis will occur first, followed by the development of advanced gum disease, deterioration of overall health, and if the patient is in a sensitive period such as pregnancy, it may even endanger the life of the baby.
What should be done to maintain periodontal health?

There are many ways to protect periodontal health. Periodontal health is generally related to maintaining the cleanliness of the entire oral cavity, especially the gums. In this context, the first thing to pay attention to is oral and dental hygiene in order to perform periodontal care at home. Oral and dental hygiene is not just about using a toothbrush and toothpaste; you should also use materials such as dental floss, mouthwash, or irrigators to thoroughly clean your mouth and leave no room for poor hygiene.
How much does periodontal treatment cost?

The prices of periodontal treatment, i.e., the cost of gum treatment, may vary depending on the situation. Therefore, it would not be appropriate to give a specific price for general periodontal treatment or specific procedures, such as the cost of gum recession treatment. The cost of periodontal treatment may vary depending on your overall health, your preferences, and the treatment method chosen by your dentist. For more comprehensive information on the prices of periodontal treatment, you should first visit your dentist for an examination and decide on the treatment based on a comprehensive consultation.
How long does periodontal treatment take?

The duration of periodontal treatment depends entirely on the situation. Many factors influence the duration of periodontal treatment, such as patient preferences, medical needs, or the treatment method chosen by the dentist for the individual patient. However, contrary to popular belief, periodontal treatment does not always take years. If there are positive factors in periodontal treatment, such as early diagnosis, early intervention, and the selection of the most appropriate treatment method for the patient, it is even possible to complete periodontal treatment in as little as one month.

As the name suggests, periodontitis is an advanced form of gingivitis. In the early stages of gingivitis, only the gums are affected, while in advanced gum disease, such as periodontitis, the tissues surrounding the teeth and even the jawbone are affected. Because periodontitis is an advanced health problem, certain surgical methods, also known as periodontal surgery, are used to treat it. If periodontitis is ignored and neglected, not only can a person’s oral and dental health be at risk, but so can their overall health. In addition, the development of advanced gum disease can have disastrous financial consequences, as it leads to significantly higher costs of periodontal treatment than the costs of treating gum disease associated with gingivitis.
### Gingival hyperplasia (gum enlargement)

In some cases, gum growth is due to health problems related to hormonal imbalances, and in other cases, it is due to a lack of oral and dental care. As the name suggests, with gum growth, the gums may begin to cover the teeth like sagging tissue and even create a strange appearance called gum hypertrophy. Excessive gum growth is one of the serious health problems that raise concerns about gum health. However, in order to address the problem of excessive gum growth, other doctors who deal with a person’s hormonal status are also consulted at the periodontal clinic to create a personalized and appropriate treatment plan. Periodontal specialists can perform surgical procedures to treat excessive gum growth.
## What are the symptoms of periodontal disease?

Periodontal diseases are health problems that are not very insidious, meaning that they manifest themselves with fairly visible symptoms. The symptoms of periodontal disease, i.e., signs that indicate that gum health is not in good condition, can be discussed in several points.
### Bleeding and swelling of the gums

Bleeding and swelling of the gums are among the most obvious symptoms of periodontal disease. Bleeding gums, especially frequent bleeding or swelling, cannot be considered normal. Bleeding and swelling of the gums are a general symptom of gum disease or periodontal disease. Therefore, if your gums are bleeding and swollen, do not delay in making an appointment with a periodontist.
### Loose teeth and bad breath

Another symptom of periodontal disease is loose teeth and bad breath. Especially in advanced stages of gum disease, teeth begin to loosen and a very unpleasant problem of bad breath appears, because the health of the teeth is now completely compromised. Loose teeth indicate that you should immediately see a periodontist, because if you do not seek medical help at this stage, you may lose your teeth completely.
## How is periodontal treatment performed?

The method of periodontal treatment, i.e., procedures performed in the periodontology department, may vary depending on the situation. The method of periodontal treatment depends on the cost of gum treatment, the patient’s preferences and medical needs, as well as the dentist’s opinion. However, in general, periodontal treatment can be divided into several categories.
### Tartar removal and root planing

Periodontal treatment most often involves tartar removal and root planing. Special devices with vibrating tips are usually used to remove tartar in periodontology. In addition to these devices, very precise medical instruments are also used for thorough cleaning. Root planing is performed with instruments called curettes. Curettes are instruments used to clean the surface of tooth roots, ensuring precise and effective results. Root planing can become particularly important and necessary, especially in the case of pocket formation.
### Advanced surgical methods (flap surgery, grafts)

Another type of treatment in periodontology is surgery using advanced surgical methods. Even advanced gum disease can be treated with procedures that fall within the scope of periodontal surgery, such as flap tissue surgery and grafting procedures. However, to achieve effective results, these delicate surgeries must be performed by a specialist periodontist.
### Laser periodontal treatment

Advances in periodontology have also led to the use of innovative laser-assisted treatment methods. Especially in cases of gum disease such as gingival hyperplasia, laser technology can be used to trim the gums without surgical intervention. This has a positive effect on oral health, as damaged tissue is also removed.
### Antibiotic and drug-assisted treatment

Antibiotic and drug-assisted treatment is used to dry out gum inflammation from the inside and eliminate problems such as hormone-induced gum growth. In this context, a periodontist can provide individualized drug treatment in consultation with other doctors.
## What determines the cost of periodontal treatment?

The cost of periodontal treatment varies depending on a number of factors. The main factors influencing the cost of gum treatment, and therefore specific fees such as the cost of gum recession treatment, are the location of the medical facility where the treatment will be performed, the methods used in the treatment, and the patient’s needs. If you want to take advantage of affordable prices for treatments such as gum recession treatment or the total cost of gum treatment, you can choose Dentaliva, which is one of the gum treatment clinics in Istanbul and offers affordable prices.
## The impact of periodontal health on overall health

Periodontal health affects not only oral and dental health, but also overall health. Deterioration of periodontal health, or in other words, the onset of gum disease, can even cause blood sugar levels to deteriorate, leading to diseases such as diabetes.
### The importance of periodontal health during pregnancy

Hormonal irregularities and other sensitive changes that occur during pregnancy put women at additional risk for periodontal health problems. Therefore, women should consult a specialist by making an appointment with a periodontist, even if they are only planning to become pregnant, and remain under supervision throughout their pregnancy.
## Frequently Asked Questions
### How to make an appointment with a periodontist?

Appointments with a periodontist can be made in various ways, depending on the situation. The method of making appointments with a periodontist varies depending on the healthcare facility you choose. The appointment process may differ between public hospitals and private healthcare facilities. If you would like to take advantage of Dentaliva’s periodontal examinations and treatments, you can make an appointment with a periodontist by contacting us via our website or WhatsApp support line.
### Are periodontal treatments very painful?

It is commonly believed that periodontal treatments are very painful. However, this belief is actually misleading and, in some cases, should be considered a myth. Periodontal treatments are not always very painful. In some cases, you can undergo periodontal treatment without feeling any pain. Especially with innovative treatment methods such as laser gum cutting, which is performed under local anesthesia, you will not feel any pain during the procedure.
### What happens if periodontal treatment is not performed?

The consequences of not undergoing periodontal treatment may vary depending on the extent of the treatment and the patient’s overall health. If a periodontist recommends periodontal treatment to a patient, or even considers it necessary, it is important not to waste time. Delaying and not undergoing periodontal treatment means that minor health problems such as gingivitis will occur first, followed by the development of advanced gum disease, deterioration of overall health, and if the patient is in a sensitive period such as pregnancy, it may even endanger the life of the baby.
### What should be done to maintain periodontal health?

There are many ways to protect periodontal health. Periodontal health is generally related to maintaining the cleanliness of the entire oral cavity, especially the gums. In this context, the first thing to pay attention to is oral and dental hygiene in order to perform periodontal care at home. Oral and dental hygiene is not just about using a toothbrush and toothpaste; you should also use materials such as dental floss, mouthwash, or irrigators to thoroughly clean your mouth and leave no room for poor hygiene.
### How much does periodontal treatment cost?

The prices of periodontal treatment, i.e., the cost of gum treatment, may vary depending on the situation. Therefore, it would not be appropriate to give a specific price for general periodontal treatment or specific procedures, such as the cost of gum recession treatment. The cost of periodontal treatment may vary depending on your overall health, your preferences, and the treatment method chosen by your dentist. For more comprehensive information on the prices of periodontal treatment, you should first visit your dentist for an examination and decide on the treatment based on a comprehensive consultation.
### How long does periodontal treatment take?

The duration of periodontal treatment depends entirely on the situation. Many factors influence the duration of periodontal treatment, such as patient preferences, medical needs, or the treatment method chosen by the dentist for the individual patient. However, contrary to popular belief, periodontal treatment does not always take years. If there are positive factors in periodontal treatment, such as early diagnosis, early intervention, and the selection of the most appropriate treatment method for the patient, it is even possible to complete periodontal treatment in as little as one month.
