blocks.text: Orthodontics is a field that deals with the diagnosis and treatment of many problems related to oral and dental diseases. In the field of orthodontics, problems related to the incorrect positioning of teeth in relation to the jawbone are primarily addressed. That is why, when it comes to orthodontic treatment, many people think of classic treatment methods, such as braces, which aim to improve the alignment of teeth. Istanbul is one of the best places to find the best orthodontic treatment facilities, as it is a highly developed city in terms of healthcare services.

In particular, thanks to professional orthodontic clinics in Istanbul, such as Dentaliva, you can benefit from comprehensive orthodontic treatments and prices calculated according to the relevant orthodontic fee schedule. In addition, to get information about the orthodontic department and details of the treatments performed in this department, you can continue reading our article.
How does orthodontic treatment work?

Orthodontic treatment can vary depending on the situation. In fact, there is no single specific method that can be called orthodontic treatment. Orthodontic treatment means treatment that will ensure the correct alignment of a person’s teeth, making them more functional, healthy, and aesthetic. Therefore, orthodontic treatment is not the same for everyone. There are many different methods of orthodontic treatment, from classic braces to transparent aligners, known by the medical name Invisalign. The method of orthodontic treatment and the appropriate stages of orthodontic treatment for a given person can be explained in a few points.
Treatment with braces (metal and clear braces)

The most popular method of orthodontic treatment is treatment with braces. Treatment with braces is an effective method of solving problems related to misaligned teeth or, as it is commonly called, crooked teeth, which can occur in both childhood and adulthood. Although orthodontic treatment is commonly considered expensive and painful, in reality, thanks to innovative methods and affordable prices for endodontic treatment, it can be carried out in an economical and comfortable manner.

Orthodontic treatment is quite comprehensive. Transparent and metal braces are mainly used in orthodontic treatment. Orthodontic treatment, in addition to braces, also includes wires called orthodontic arches and small rubber bands. These three materials are connected to each other and exert pressure on the teeth that does not harm their health but is sufficient to correct alignment problems, providing comprehensive and effective orthodontic treatment. Many orthodontic specialists recommend braces treatment for people who have serious teeth alignment problems and are looking for comprehensive solutions. Braces treatment is one of the few methods that does not cause the likelihood of deterioration of the condition of the teeth after the end of orthodontic treatment. However, although rare, orthodontic treatment may need to be reinforced with other types of orthodontic treatment. The cost of braces may seem unfavorable compared to other options, but due to the effective results of treatment, it is still the preferred treatment method for many people.
Treatment with clear aligners (orthodontics without braces)

One of the most comfortable and aesthetic treatments performed in the field of orthodontics is treatment with clear aligners, commonly known as orthodontics without braces, and medically as Invisalign. In treatment with clear aligners, special aligners are prepared, taking into account the material chosen by the patient depending on factors such as the cost of orthodontic treatment and the dimensions of the teeth. These special aligners are usually used as recommended by an orthodontist during activities such as eating and drinking, and less often only during sleep.

While using aligners, you should regularly visit medical facilities such as Dentaliva, which is among the options for orthodontic clinics in Istanbul, to have necessary procedures such as aligner replacement performed. Replacing aligners and, depending on the situation, increasing the pressure on the teeth is of great importance for ensuring proper tooth alignment.

Treatment with clear aligners is generally suitable for people who have minimal tooth alignment problems and do not require complex methods such as orthodontic surgery or, in other words, jaw surgery. Considering the prices of orthodontic treatment in clinics that have adopted a policy of providing affordable health services, such as Dentaliva, one of the options for orthodontic clinics in Istanbul, it can be said that treatment with clear aligners is a method that combines affordability with comfort.
Lingual orthodontics

Lingual orthodontics is a much more innovative and complex method compared to other methods. Lingual orthodontics is actually performed using the materials and methods used in classic orthodontic treatments. However, in this method, braces are attached not to the surface of the teeth, but to their inner part. In this way, problems related to the incorrect positioning of the teeth in relation to the jawbone can be solved by applying pressure to the teeth. However, due to the fact that lingual orthodontics is a rather complicated method and can increase the cost of braces, it may be the most expensive method among all orthodontic treatment methods.

In addition, not every orthodontic clinic in Istanbul can perform orthodontic treatment using the lingual method, as it is a rather delicate method. Lingual orthodontics is one of the first treatment methods recommended by an orthodontist for people who have high aesthetic expectations and do not want their braces to be visible during treatment. It is much more effective than treatment with clear aligners and, unlike traditional braces, it is invisible, which offers many advantages.
Who are orthodontic treatments intended for?

Orthodontic treatments, or in other words orthodontic procedures, are suitable for many different types of patients. These treatments allow people of all ages to get rid of crooked teeth, commonly known as dental misalignment. Who orthodontic treatments are intended for can be explained in a few points.
Children and adolescents

The first group of patients covered by orthodontic treatment are children and adolescents. Children and adolescents in particular can achieve effective results in a very short time with orthodontic treatment because their jaws are not yet fully developed. Therefore, parents are advised to make an appointment with an orthodontist immediately if their children have crooked teeth. On the other hand, in addition to adolescents, young adult patients can also benefit from orthodontic treatment to get rid of problems associated with crooked teeth.
Orthodontics for adults

Many people believe that orthodontic treatment, such as braces, is only used for children or adolescents, but this is not the case. Adults can also benefit from orthodontic treatment. Orthodontic treatment in adults takes longer, is more cumbersome, and the cost of braces can be significantly higher than for children. However, adults who consider the cost of orthodontic treatment to be very high and avoid the expense of braces may experience much greater problems, both aesthetic and health-related, as a result of misaligned teeth.
Advantages of orthodontic treatment

Orthodontic treatment has many advantages. Of course, the results of each orthodontic treatment and the level of its effectiveness may vary depending on how it is performed. However, in general, the advantages of orthodontic treatment can be explained in a few points.
Aesthetic smile

One of the biggest advantages of orthodontic treatment is achieving an aesthetic smile. Improperly aligned, crooked teeth can make it difficult to achieve an aesthetic smile, even if their size and color meet general aesthetic standards. However, with orthodontic treatment, the teeth will be properly aligned, resulting in an aesthetic smile.
Improved oral and dental health

Many people believe that orthodontic treatment only improves aesthetic appearance, but this is not actually the case. Misaligned teeth not only detract from aesthetics, but can also lead to gaps between teeth and make it difficult to clean misaligned teeth. Orthodontic treatment eliminates these problems, allowing you to maintain overall oral hygiene and improve your oral and dental health. That is why many orthodontic specialists recommend orthodontic treatment to improve oral and dental health.
Improved chewing and speech

Malocclusion, or crooked and tilted teeth, can also negatively affect chewing and speech functions. In particular, gaps between teeth and extreme malocclusion can make it difficult to produce certain sounds and chew food properly, which can cause problems. Orthodontics helps to solve these problems. This improves both chewing and speech function.
What does orthodontic treatment look like?

The method of orthodontic treatment may vary depending on the situation. Contrary to popular belief, orthodontic treatment is not uniform and is not based on standard procedures, as many different methods are used in orthodontics. Orthodontic treatment is carried out in different ways, depending on the method chosen and the individual medical needs of the patient. However, for any type of orthodontic treatment, a comprehensive examination is first performed, followed by the development of a treatment plan tailored to the patient’s needs. Orthodontic treatment is carried out with great care, especially in reputable medical facilities such as Dentaliva, which is one of the options for an orthodontic clinic in Istanbul.
What to keep in mind before and after orthodontic treatment

There are many things to keep in mind before and after orthodontic treatment. The first factor to consider before orthodontic treatment, which will affect the entire process, is the choice of a medical facility that offers comprehensive services at reliable and appropriate orthodontic treatment prices. These types of medical facilities determine the range of orthodontic prices according to the patient’s requirements and needs, and then offer treatment services within the appropriate range of orthodontic prices. This allows you to benefit from safe, affordable, and comprehensive treatments. The issues to pay attention to after orthodontic treatment may vary depending on the situation. However, in general, to avoid problems such as deterioration of the condition of the teeth after orthodontic treatment, it is necessary to take care of oral and dental hygiene and strictly follow the dentist’s recommendations.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does orthodontic treatment cost?

The prices of orthodontic treatment are determined based on many factors. Therefore, it is not appropriate to provide specific information about the price of orthodontic treatment for a given person. Since each person’s orthodontic treatment needs and requirements, the treatment methods chosen, and the cost of the medical materials used may vary, the prices of orthodontic treatment are not fixed and may vary depending on the situation and the person. For all these reasons, you should first consult your dentist for information on the prices of orthodontic treatment.
Can jaw surgery be performed without orthodontic treatment?

Jaw surgery can be performed without orthodontic treatment. However, this does not apply to all cases. Whether a person can undergo jaw surgery without orthodontic treatment depends on both their own preferences and the opinion of a dental specialist. In some cases, it is recommended that patients first be offered orthodontic treatment, and if this treatment does not produce the desired results, jawbone surgery may be considered. In some cases, however, because jaw surgery is the real solution to the problem, the surgery is performed first, and then, depending on the situation, orthodontic treatment may be considered.
At what age does orthodontic treatment begin?

The age at which orthodontic treatment begins may vary depending on the situation. Orthodontic treatment usually begins at the age of at least 7-8 years. The main reason for this is that before this age, there are still baby teeth in the mouth, and the permanent teeth that require orthodontic treatment have not yet grown in. However, in some cases, when children have early eruption of permanent teeth and serious problems, orthodontic treatment may be started at a much younger age.
Is orthodontic treatment performed in public hospitals?

Orthodontic treatment can be performed in public hospitals. Of course, public hospitals are healthcare facilities that meet various requirements, which is why they can perform orthodontic treatment. However, it can be quite difficult to find an appointment for orthodontic treatment at a public hospital. The main reason for this is the heavy workload of public hospitals, especially specialist departments such as orthodontics. In addition, the possibility of orthodontic treatment at a public hospital also depends on the opinion of the orthodontist treating the patient at that hospital.
Is orthodontic treatment painful?

Whether orthodontic treatment is painful depends on the specific case. Whether a person feels pain during orthodontic treatment depends on factors such as the person’s low or high pain threshold, the type of treatment chosen, and the experience of the orthodontist performing the treatment. However, in general, even complex orthodontic procedures, such as treatment with braces, do not cause extreme pain during treatment and are even completely painless for some people. However, after the procedure, there may be minimal pain and discomfort caused by pressure.
How long does orthodontic treatment take?

The duration of orthodontic treatment depends on the specific case. However, contrary to popular belief, not all orthodontic treatments have to take many years. The duration of orthodontic treatment depends on the chosen treatment method, the orthodontist’s experience, and the severity of the person’s teeth alignment problems. Therefore, to find out how many months orthodontic treatment will take, you should consult your dentist.

Laminates should be performed by dentists with experience and knowledge in the field of veneers, who can be called specialists in aesthetic veneers. This allows you to see the differences between the condition before and after the application of laminates and maximise the benefits of this method.

Teeth laminating, if not performed by a dentist specialising in this field and carried out in conditions that do not provide adequate facilities, can unfortunately cause more risks than benefits. Therefore, when it comes to clinics offering laminating, you should choose one of the options that first come to mind, such as Dentaliva, which satisfies its patients. To obtain information about veneers, it is necessary to understand details such as the profiles of patients who can use veneers and how they are applied.
Who can benefit from veneers?

blocks.text: Some developments in dentistry have made it possible to use even a tooth that has lost almost all of its structure both functionally and aesthetically. In particular, inlay and onlay fillings are types of fillings that offer significant advantages in this regard. In fact, inlays and onlays are comprehensive treatment methods that can even be considered as tooth coverings depending on the situation. Thanks to inlay and onlay fillings, tooth loss can be prevented in many cases, and the tooth can continue to be used functionally.

types performed by specialist inlay and onlay dentists, i.e., dentists who have gained enough experience to perform the best filling applications. When Are Inlays and Onlays Preferred?

There are multiple situations where inlay and onlay fillings may be preferred. Depending on the difference between inlays and onlays, these two types of fillings can be preferred in different situations, but due to their structures, they generally cannot be used at the same time. The situations in which specialist inlay dentists resort to inlay and onlay fillings can be explained under several headings.
Occurrence of Very Large Cavities

Although teeth are quite sturdy structures, they can begin to decay due to factors such as impact and neglect of dental health. Tooth decay is considered one of the main causes of tooth loss in many cases because, in advanced tooth decay, not only the tooth surface (enamel) but also the internal structures of the tooth can be damaged. For this reason, inlay and onlay fillings can be used as part of cavity treatment. Many people think that filling types such as composite fillings are sufficient for all types of cavity treatment, but this is not actually the case.

In cases of very large cavities, the use of traditional fillings may not be sufficient treatment, or even if it provides an immediate solution, the effects of this solution are not long-lasting. For example, applying a composite filling after cleaning a very large cavity can cause the composite filling to fall out during functions such as chewing, despite its chemical bonding effect to the tooth. However, inlay and onlay dental filling procedures performed by specialist inlay and onlay dentists at healthcare institutions that meet the appropriate conditions, such as Dentaliva, which is among the aesthetic inlay filling options in Istanbul, can offer comprehensive solutions even for large cavities.
When Traditional Filling Treatments Fail to Provide a Solution or Sensitivity is an Issue

Some individuals cannot find a solution with classic filling treatments or may experience sensitivity problems as a result of these treatments. The main reason for this situation is that in classic filling treatments, the filling material is applied to the cavity in the tooth and loses its functionality to a certain extent due to factors such as wear or shrinkage after drying.

This loss of functionality can lead to many sensitive situations, from food accumulation and bacterial growth to gum disease. However, this is not really the case for inlays and onlays, which are among the types of dental fillings. Inlays and onlays are fillings produced in a specialized laboratory environment and fitted to the tooth like its original part, so they do not cause unsolvable problems or sensitive situations. Many people find it much more reasonable to pay for inlay and onlay filling prices once and get long-term solutions than to pay repeatedly for classic filling applications. One of the main reasons why specialist inlay and onlay dentists strongly recommend these procedures when deemed necessary is the advantages offered by long-term solutions.
Differences Between Inlay and Onlay Fillings and Traditional Fillings

The difference between inlay and onlay and traditional procedures can be considered in many ways. In traditional filling procedures, materials such as composite filling material are applied to the cavity in the tooth after procedures such as decay removal. Applying the filling material to the cavity in the tooth and allowing it to dry and harden may, in some cases, provide an insufficient or short-term solution. In inlay and onlay fillings, unlike traditional fillings, the filling material is prepared in a laboratory environment to suit the individual and the tooth. Although inlay and onlay porcelain fillings may seem like an expensive option, they offer much more effective results than traditional fillings.

Individuals with Extensive Decay or Damaged Teeth

The most common patient profile for inlay and onlay fillings are individuals with extensive decay or damaged teeth. In cases of decay or damage where a large portion of the tooth is lost or about to be lost, traditional fillings cannot provide a solution, but inlay and onlay fillings can offer comprehensive solutions.

Initial Examination and Tooth Preparation Stages

During this examination, a consultation takes place between the patient and the dentist, and the patient is informed about the total inlay onlay treatment cost and factors such as the choice of materials that determine the inlay onlay treatment cost. The placement stage is then carried out with the procedures performed and the carefully prepared inlay and onlay fillings. Functional and aesthetic inlay fillings in Istanbul are carefully placed into the tooth cavity at professional healthcare institutions such as Dentaliva, and this also applies to onlay fillings.
Types of Inlays and Onlays

It makes perfect sense to classify inlay and onlay fillings according to their materials, as the materials used affect many different factors, from inlay and onlay filling prices to the lifespan of the filling. After a significant procedure such as smile aesthetics, which is both therapeutic and cosmetic in nature, it is necessary to have regular dental checkups. Clean your teeth with oral and dental care products that are suitable for the procedures you have undergone. You can make the right choices by paying attention to your dentist’s recommendations when selecting products.

Short Treatment Time and Fast Recovery

One of the most important advantages of All on Four implants is that they can be performed with a short treatment process and allow individuals to recover quickly. In classic implant treatments, the treatment and recovery processes that individuals will undergo can be quite long due to various circumstances, such as the need for individual applications. However, with the all-on-four implant treatment, which offers comprehensive prosthesis use with 4 implants, it is possible to benefit from implant treatment with a very short treatment process and a fast recovery process. In particular, thanks to the placement of temporary and fixed prostheses on the same day, individuals are not left without teeth during the treatment process.

In classic implant treatments, if the individual’s bone density is insufficient, a bone grafting procedure, or in other words, a procedure to increase bone density with bone powder, is performed. Since only 4 implants are used in the All on 4 implant application, even individuals with low jawbone density can benefit from implant treatment without bone grafting.
Natural Appearance and High Functional Comfort

All on four implant treatment is also quite advantageous in terms of providing a natural appearance and high functional comfort. With All on Four implant treatment, it is possible to use prostheses that are fixed according to the individual’s wishes and needs, thus achieving a natural tooth appearance. On the other hand, the fact that these prostheses offer comfort in terms of functions such as chewing and speaking is also a significant advantage.

After All on Four implant treatment, many things need to be considered. The points to be considered should be addressed as things to pay attention to in the early recovery period, such as the first few days, and recommendations for long-term oral hygiene and care routines.
Things to Pay Attention to in the First Few Days

Since All on Four implant treatment is a very important and complex treatment, it is necessary to be careful during the early recovery period, such as the first few days after this treatment. In the first few days after implant treatment, it is necessary to avoid external factors that may cause sensitivity in the mouth, such as very hot and very cold foods. In addition, you should take care to brush your teeth gently and avoid consuming very hard foods so as not to strain the temporary prostheses and implants.
Long-Term Oral Hygiene and Care Routine

All on 4 implant Including any implant use, long-term care is required. As part of this care, you need to consider recommendations for a care routine that will maintain oral hygiene. You need to thoroughly clean the teeth placed on the implant, without distinguishing them from your natural teeth, carefully and in accordance with your dentist’s recommendations. In addition, you should remember that people who use implants need to have regular dental check-ups, even if they do not experience any problems.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does an All on Four implant cost?

The price of an All on Four implant is determined by several factors. All on four prices refer to the total all on four treatment cost. Therefore, many different factors affect the price of all on four implant treatment, from the cost of a 4-implant prosthesis to the experience of the dentist performing the procedure, the conditions of the healthcare facility where the procedure will be performed, and the individual’s specific requests. For this reason, you need to consult a dentist to get clear and comprehensive information about the all on four implant price.
How long does the recovery process for All-on-4 implant treatment take?

The length of the recovery process after All-on-4 implant treatment depends on multiple factors. When it comes to any implant treatment, including All-on-4 implants, you should not expect recovery in extremely short periods, such as a few days. However, since the All-on-4 implant is a highly innovative and advantageous method, when this method is used, unlike classic implant treatments, it is possible to start using temporary prostheses on the same day the implants are placed and to fully recover within a short period of 4-6 months.
How long can All-on-4 implants be used?

How long All-on-4 implants can be used, or in other words, the lifespan of All-on-4 implants, can vary depending on the situation. All-on-4 implants, or quadruple artificial tooth roots, can be used for long periods of time, such as 35-50 years, or in other words, for a lifetime, just like other types of implants. However, the prosthetic teeth on All-on-4 implants do not last as long as the implants themselves and may need to be replaced after 15 years or so.
Are All-on-4 implants painful?

When it comes to all implant treatments, including All-on-4 implants, people are deeply concerned that they will experience a lot of pain. However, implant treatments today are not as extremely painful as people think. Especially when it comes to innovative treatments like All-on-4 implants, which use a small number of artificial tooth roots, pain is minimized. Since local anesthesia is used when the implants are placed, you won’t feel anything, but you may experience minimal pain during the early healing process after treatment, which can be controlled with painkillers.
Can you eat normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment?

You cannot eat normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment. Eating normally immediately after a complex dental treatment involving local anesthesia, including All-on-4 treatment, is highly inadvisable for two reasons. The first reason is that it can worsen the already sensitive condition inside the mouth. The other reason is that the numbness caused by local anesthesia may make it difficult to chew, potentially leading to choking. Therefore, it is necessary to wait until the numbness subsides and then consume semi-liquid foods such as soup instead of eating normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment.
Is All-on-4 implant treatment suitable for everyone?

All-on-four implant treatment is one of the rare treatment methods that can be applied to multiple patient profiles. However, like all other treatments, all-on-four implant treatment cannot be applied to everyone. Individuals with very advanced bone loss, i.e., those who have lost most of their bone density, pregnant or breastfeeding women, people with chronic diseases such as diabetes, and heavy smokers may not be considered suitable candidates for All-on-Four implant treatment.

How long All-on-4 implants can be used, or in other words, the lifespan of All-on-4 implants, can vary depending on the situation. All-on-4 implants, or quadruple artificial tooth roots, can be used for long periods of time, such as 35-50 years, or in other words, for a lifetime, just like other types of implants. ### Are All-on-4 implants painful?

When it comes to all implant treatments, including All-on-4 implants, people are deeply concerned that they will experience a lot of pain. However, implant treatments today are not as extremely painful as people think. Especially when it comes to innovative treatments like All-on-4 implants, which use a small number of artificial tooth roots, pain is minimized. ### Can you eat normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment?

You cannot eat normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment. Eating normally immediately after a complex dental treatment involving local anesthesia, including All-on-4 treatment, is highly inadvisable for two reasons. The first reason is that it can worsen the already sensitive condition inside the mouth. The other reason is that the numbness caused by local anesthesia may make it difficult to chew, potentially leading to choking. Therefore, it is necessary to wait until the numbness subsides and then consume semi-liquid foods such as soup instead of eating normally immediately after All-on-4 treatment.
### Is All-on-4 implant treatment suitable for everyone?

All-on-four implant treatment is one of the rare treatment methods that can be applied to multiple patient profiles. However, like all other treatments, all-on-four implant treatment cannot be applied to everyone. Individuals with very advanced bone loss, i.e., those who have lost most of their bone density, pregnant or breastfeeding women, people with chronic diseases such as diabetes, and heavy smokers may not be considered suitable candidates for All-on-Four implant treatment.
